[[Aumark Lithyl]], one of [[Knights of Myth Drannor]], leads a defense of the island.<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p43">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Set/DM's Sourcebook of the Realms|43}}</ref><ref name="TGHotR-142" />

Together, they destroy a [[dark elf]] caravan travelling near Shadowdale and help [[Randal Morn]] of [[Daggerdale]] fight off an [[orc]] incursion from the [[Desertsmouth Mountains]].<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p44">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Set/DM's Sourcebook of the Realms|44}}</ref>

* [[Marpenoth]]: After a particularly vicious battle between the forces of [[Hillsfar]] and those of Zhentil Keep, the Hillsfar faction, led by [[Maalthiir]], wins control of [[Yûlash]]. * Lord Envoy [[Orm]]'s desertion<ref name="FRA-p125">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Adventures|125}}</ref> sparks civil war in [[Melvaunt]], as senior families fight to control the throne.<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p44"/>
* Uktar: The [[Zhentilar]] retake Yûlash with an inferior number of troops supported by powerful magic. * A second [[Thay]]an army, this one bolstered by the [[zombie]] forces of [[Myrkul's Legion]], invades [[Rashemen]] but is turned back.<ref name="Sb-MC-p4">{{Cite book/Spellbound/Monstrous Compendium|4}}</ref><ref name="DotRW-p59">{{Cite book/Dreams of the Red Wizards|59-60}}</ref>
* ''Circa'': A fleet of the [[mamluk]]s of [[Qudra]] tries to take control of the [[Corsair (kit)|corsair]] city of [[Hawa]]. The attack is beaten back with severe losses to the Qudran navy.<ref name="CGS">{{Cite book/Corsairs of the Great Sea/Campaign Guide|24}}</ref>{{AQ-time}}
*[[Kythorn]]: The forces of [[Zhengyi the Witch-King]] triumph over [[Damara]] at the first [[Battle of Goliad]].<ref name="TGHotR-142" /><ref name="FRCS3e-p110">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|110}}</ref><ref name="BL-p3">{{Cite book/The Bloodstone Lands|3-6}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/deaths}}
*[[Kythorn]]: King [[Virdin Bloodfeathers]] of Damara dies in battle with [[Zhengyi]] the Witch-King at the [[Ford of Goliad]].<ref name="TGHotR-142" /><ref name="FRCS3e-p108">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|108}}</ref>

*[[Vendes Baenre]], a vicious [[drow]] priestess popular in [[Gracklstugh]] for her "sculpted" ebony statues transmuted from living beings.<ref name="Guide-61">{{Cite book/Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark|61}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-environment}}
*Tarsakh: Many strange creatures, including a great number of [[troll]]s appear in the [[Yuirwood]] south of [[Aglarond]].<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p42" />

{{Yearbox/in-organizations}}

*Tarsakh: The [[Men of the Purple Arrow]] explore the regions around the Yuirwood and the adventurer [[Sparleye]] goes missing.<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p42" />

* [[Marpenoth]]: The [[Rogues of Tilverton]] are attacked in their own headquarters by the [[Fire Knives]] but that same contingent of Fire Knives is then defeated by an adventuring party inscribed with the [[Azure Bonds]] (which they had helped to inscribe!).<ref>{{Cite book/Curse of the Azure Bonds}}</ref>
*Uktar: The Knights of Myth Drannor destroy the ''[[portal]]'' to [[Avernus]] located in the ruins of [[Myth Drannor]].<ref name="VG:MD-p103">{{Cite dragon/359/Volo's Guide: Myth Drannor, City of Song|103}}</ref>
*Nightal: A mercenary company, under the leadership of [[Narve Dwarfkin]] and [[Ryhinn Blackcloak]] forms in the city of Selgaunt.<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p45" />

*[[Hammer (month)|Hammer]]: [[Liantha]], a [[priest]]ess of [[Tymora]] in [[Silverymoon]] sets out eastward with a band of adventurers looking for passageway across the [[Anauroch]] desert to the [[Eastern Heartlands]].<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p40">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Set/DM's Sourcebook of the Realms|40}}</ref>
*Alturiak: [[Mellomir]], the [[sage]] of Arabel claims discovery of a great dwarfhold located deep underneath the village of [[Eveningstar]]. He is believed to have been taken to [[High Horn]] for questioning by a group of [[Cormyr]]ean guards.<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p40" />
*[[Tarsakh]]: [[Dabron Sashenstar]] returns to [[Baldur's Gate]] after a successful expedition to [[Sossal]].<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p42" />

*Eleint: [[Lurkan|Lurkan the Reaver]] of the Sword Coast travels to the region around the Inner Sea to lend his services to the growing conflict in the Moonsea region.<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p44" />
*Marpenoth: [[Thaalim Torchtower]] rises to lead the lawless men of the [[Tunlands]] between the [[Storm Horns]] and the [[Sunset Mountains]]. Rumors spread that he has spies in all the settlements of Cormyr (though in reality he only has one spy in [[Eagle's Peak]]).<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p44" />
*The bandit-lord [[Lothchas]] of the Moonsea shifts his operation from that region to the Dalelands to the south.<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p44" />
*[[Nightal]]: [[Haspur]], a seer in [[Baldur's Gate]], has a vision that prophesies the rediscovery of the ''[[Ring of Winter (artifact)|Ring of Winter]]'' in the near future. *An inexperienced [[Harper]] bard named [[Mestrel Hawkmantle]] succeeds at an extraordinary amount of tasks before disappearing through a ''[[portal]]'' that he found in some ancient ruins.<ref name="tCotH-p14-18">{{Cite book/The Code of the Harpers|14-18}}</ref>

*[[Shaliim Wyrmslayer]], the prince of [[Lapaliiya]], and his Waterdhavian adventuring party narrowly escape capture by a group of [[black dragon]]s.<ref name="TGHotR-142" />
*[[Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun]] steals the ''[[Scepter of the Sorcerer-Kings]]'' from a [[Harper]] vault called the [[Catacombs of Ordulin]]. He replaces it with an illusory replica.<ref name="TGHotR-142" />
* The [[bard]] [[Ivryn Olindarr]] writes the comedic play ''[[Three Black Horses]]''.<ref>{{Cite polyhedron/115/Elminster's Everwinking Eye: The Sage of Shadowdale returns!|18}}</ref>
*[[Malarkin Norlbertusz]] of [[Ordulin]] writes the play ''[[Much Ado in Sembia]]''.<ref>{{Cite book/Crown of Fire/TPB 2002|301|19}}</ref>

* [[Thauloamur Reerist]], a minstrel, writes the book ''[[Clever Words from a Failed Jester]]''.<ref>{{Cite book/Elminster's Daughter/MMP|59}}</ref>
*[[Thalamoasz Threir]], Sage of [[Sembia]], writes ''[[Signposts In The Gardens of Life]]''.<ref>{{Cite book/Elminster's Daughter/MMP|77}}</ref>
*[[Pumkato]], a [[svirfneblin]] of [[Blingdenstone]], rises to the position of burrow warden, one of the youngest in the city's history.<ref name="Guide-37">{{Cite book/Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark|37}}</ref>
*On the alternate world of [[Earth]], [[Ed Greenwood]] collates a collection of travelogues, maps, and other information given him by [[Elminster]] into the ''[[Forgotten Realms Campaign Set]]'' for its first publication.<ref name="TGHotR-142">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|142,144}}</ref>
*In the guise of the [[halfling]] [[Regis]], the assassin [[Artemis Entreri]] comes to [[Mithral Hall]]. He battles [[Drizzt Do'Urden]], but is defeated and left for dead. Later this year, while Drizzt and Catti-brie escape the city, he joins them.<ref name="TGHotR-142" />
*[[Shandril Shessair]], a ''[[spellfire]]''-wielding maiden of [[Deepingdale]], is hunted by both the [[Cult of the Dragon]] and the [[Zhentarim]] across the [[Dalelands]] and [[Cormyr]] and into the [[Heartlands]]. On the way, she is aided by the [[Knights of Myth Drannor]] and hidden by [[Elminster]], [[Mirt]], and the [[Seven Sisters]]. *Shandril Shessair later kills a clone of [[Manshoon]], collapses [[Irondrake Rock]], slays the [[lich]]nee [[Iliph Thraun]] and does heavy damage to [[Zhentil Keep]] and the [[Citadel of the Raven]] with ''spellfire''.<ref name="CrownofFire">{{Cite book/Crown of Fire}}</ref>
*The Dragon Cult and Zhentarim continue to hunt Shandril, until finally she immolates herself in ''[[spellfire]]''.<ref name="TGHotR-142" />
*Heading to Silverymoon at the invitation of [[Alustriel]], [[Drizzt Do'Urden]] comes across the path of a band of [[orc]] and [[ogre]] raiders and their captives. Having been told the goblin was a captured war band leader who was to have a trial, Drizzt tracks him down and returns him, whereupon he learns that Nojheim is as temperamentally different a goblin as Drizzt is a drow, and a slave owned by [[Rico Pengallen]]. Traveling to Silverymoon to appeal to Alustriel's justice, Drizzt isn't there to stop Nojheim's owner from killing him.<ref name="RoV-DM">{{Cite book/Realms of Valor/Dark Mirror|302–334}}</ref>
*[[Alias]] and [[Dragonbait]] track down the makers of the Azure Bonds. *On the island of [[Shinkoku]] in [[Kozakura]], Lady [[Sato Kitashi]] befriended several [[li lung]] dragons.<ref>{{Cite book/Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms/Volume II|138}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
*Marpenoth: Zhentil Keep's grip on the cities of the Moonsea loosens as the Zhents become distracted by warfare further south.<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p44" />
*[[Orm]], the Lord Envoy of the [[Council of Lords (Melvaunt)|Council of Lords]] of Melvaunt, flees the city with most of the treasury and buys himself an estate north of Zhentil Keep. The Zhents recognize him as the true lord of Melvaunt regardless.<ref name="FRA-p125"/>
*[[Flamerule]]: [[Azoun IV]] attempts to strengthen diplomatic ties between Cormyr, Shadowdale, [[Mistledale]], [[High Dale]], and [[Deepingdale]]. This act worsens relations with Sembia and [[Archendale]].<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p43" />
*Rumors of a merchant's or nobles' war breaking out in [[Westgate]] begin to spread in the nation of Cormyr.<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p43" /> Several dead [[assassin]]s turn up dead in the harbor of the city.<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p44" />
*[[Moonsea]] caravans sending supplies to Zhent troops in the Dalelands begin quietly changing their destination to Arabel. Zhentil Keep quickly discovers this treachery and abandons support for its occupying forces, instead concentrating on rebuilding Yûlash in an attempt to divert all Moonsea trade away from the Dalelands.<ref name="FRCS:DSR-p43" />
*During the months of Flamerule, Eleasias, and Eleint, the [[Night Masks]] battle the [[Shore Patrol]] for control of [[Westgate]]'s criminal underworld. {{LunarCalendarBox}}

{{Yearbox/in-deities}}
* [[Bahamut]] regains his status as a deity after [[Gareth Dragonsbane]] plants the [[Tree-Gem of Bloodstone|''Tree-Gem'']] and mortals begin to worship the platinum dragon once more.<ref name="DoF-p9">{{Cite book/Dragons of Faerûn|9}}</ref>
* [[Set]] attacks and imprisons [[Sseth]], adopting Sseth's guise to gain the worship of his serpentfolk followers.<ref>{{Cite dragon/313/Faiths of Faerun: Elder Serpents of Set|85}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* [[Mirtul]]: [[Gareth Dragonsbane]] becomes Baron of [[Bloodstone (barony)|Bloodstone]], and invites the ire and envy of other [[Damara|Damaran]] barons and dukes when he brings one million [[gold piece]]s worth of [[bloodstone]] to market in [[Heliogabalus]] following his reclamation of the [[Bloodstone Mines]].<ref name="tBW-p8">{{Cite book/The Bloodstone Wars|8-10}}</ref><ref name="tBL-p6">{{Cite book/The Bloodstone Lands|6}}</ref>
* Gareth Dragonsbane becomes King of Damara before the end of the year.<ref name="FRCS3e-p108">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|108}}</ref>
* The Lords of [[Nimbral]] forbid organized priesthoods and state religions from being practiced in their realm, prompting many [[Leira]]n (now [[Cyric]]ist) priests to move to [[Samarach]].<ref name="GHotR-p144">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|144}}</ref>
* The people of [[Unther]] force the high priests of [[Gilgeam]] out of [[Unthalass]]. The priests and Unther's military leads retreat to the [[Citadel of Black Ash]].<ref name="GHotR-p144"/>

{{Yearbox/in-conflicts}}
* Spring/Summer:<ref name="tBL-p61">{{Cite book/The Bloodstone Lands|61}}</ref> The [[Bloodstone Wars]] occur between [[Damara]] and [[Vaasa]], and end when the Witch-King [[Zhengyi]] is killed at [[Castle Perilous]].<ref name="GHotR-p144">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|144}}</ref><ref name="FRCS2eR.RtR-18">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (Revised)/Running the Realms|18}}</ref>
* The ambitious [[Yamun Khahan]] leads the [[Tuigan Horde]] out of the [[Hordelands]] to conquer [[Khazari]] and the [[Semphar]]. Next, he breaches the [[Dragonwall]] and launches an invasion of [[Shou Lung]]. Following months of heated fighting, a truce is declared, and Yamun turns westward.<ref name="GHotR-p144"/>
* [[Thay]] is next to be invaded by the Tuigan Horde. Thayan magic overcomes the first scouting foray, but the Tuigan general [[Batu Min Ho]] leads a more effective assault. The Tuigans defeat the famous [[Griffon Legion]] and thousands of [[gnoll]]s at [[Shar's Pass]]. [[Zulkir]] [[Szass Tam]] negotiates peace with the Tuigans, then constructs a huge ''[[portal]]'' to transport them to Thay's enemy, [[Rashemen]].<ref name="GHotR-p144"/>
* Invading Rashemen via ''portal'', the Tuigans lay siege to [[Citadel Rashemar]] and destroy it, while their main force cross the [[High Country (Rashemen)|High Country]] to assault the [[Rashemi]] gathering at the [[Lake of Tears]]. Meanwhile, a Thayan army traps a force of Rashemi berserkers south of [[Lake Mulsantir]], preventing them from aiding their countrymen. The [[Witches of Rashemen|Witches]] can only slow the Tuigan Horde.<ref name="GHotR-p144"/>
* [[Ixitxachitl]] seize parts of the northeastern [[Hmur Plateau]], but are driven out before year is over.<ref name="GHotR-p144"/>

{{Yearbox/in-migrations}}
* Thousands of refugees fleeing the Tuigan Horde cross [[Lake Ashane]]. Some travel to [[Uthmere]] and settle along the [[Great Road]], where they become known as "the newcomers".<ref name="GHotR-p144"/>
* A [[dark naga]] from the Slitherswamp level of [[Undermountain]] discovers a ''[[portal]]'' that allows the nagas and [[ophidian]]s there to travel back to [[Najara]], where they were abducted from seventy years prior.<ref>{{cite book/Serpent Kingdoms|133}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/deaths}}
* [[Zhengyi]], the Witch-King of [[Vaasa]], is slain.<ref name="GHotR-p144"/>
* [[Urshula]] the [[Black dragon|Black]] is killed, and his soul trapped in a [[phylactery]].<ref name="IETHUmL">{{Cite book/The Collected Stories: The Legend of Drizzt Anthology/Paperback 2011/If Ever They Happened Upon My Lair}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-people}}
* Gareth Dragonsbane and his adventuring companions steal and destroy the ''[[Wand of Orcus]]'' in the blood of an avatar of [[Tiamat]], thwarting her plans. They leave the [[Abyss]] and return to Damara, with the blessings of Bahamut. There they plant the ''Tree-Gem'', which becomes a symbol of the covenant between Bahamut and Damara.<ref name="GHotR-p144"/> It also solidifies Gareth's rule as king of Damara.<ref name="FRCS-108">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|108}}</ref>
* Lord [[Pundun]] and his mage mentor, [[Menrick]], release the [[vampire]] [[Shyressa]] in a mausoleum outside [[Dajaan]].<ref name="FNoC-p">{{Cite book/Master of Chains|}}</ref>
* In [[Calimport]], Myrmeen Lhal battles and exposes the [[Night Parade]].<ref name="GHotR-p144" />
* [[Duskar Flamehaern]], the proprietor of [[Adderposts]] in [[Essembra]], and his family come under the sway of a [[spirit naga]] named [[Ssensariith]]. A snake cult forms around the naga and Duskar begins selling drugs and captured slaves out of the building.<ref>{{cite book/Serpent Kingdoms|171-172}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-organizations}}
* The [[Coiled Cabal]] break through [[Netheril|Netherese]] wards to enter the ruins of [[Ss'thar'tiss'ssun]], summoning guardian creatures from the [[Chultan Peninsula]].<ref>{{cite book/Serpent Kingdoms|110}}</ref>
* The [[Order of the Silver Chalice]] is formed in the month of [[Alturiak]].<ref>{{Cite book/Lands of Intrigue/Tethyr|10}}</ref>
* The [[Risen Cult of Bane]] arrives in the [[Moonshae Isles]] with bandits and [[undead]]. They manage to infiltrate [[Caer Callidyrr]] and try to kidnap the [[Tristan Kendrick|High King]]. A group of adventurers, [[Harper]]s and the archmage [[Flamsterd (person)|Flamsterd]] save the King's life after defeating an avatar of [[Iyachtu Xvim]].<ref>{{Cite book/Halls of the High King}}</ref><ref>{{Cite dragon/362/Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes|29}}</ref>
* [[Arvoreen's Marchers]] form in [[Tethyr]] to patrol and protect the [[Purple Marches]].<ref>{{Cite book/Champions of Valor|99}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-Realmspace}}
* The [[Emerald Brotherhood]] are abducted by [[illithid]]s and taken into [[Realmspace]] for a second time.<ref name="LoI-3-E&FoI-p3">{{Cite book/Lands of Intrigue/Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue|3}}</ref><ref name="Realmspace-p58">{{Cite book/Realmspace|58}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/misc}}
* ''[[Vorthryn's Archivir]]'' is taken from its resting place and finds its way into the hands of an untold number of adventurers. From [[Neverwinter]] to [[Zazesspur]] and [[Athkatla]] to [[Alaghôn]], the book is incredibly useful to those who wield it and it serves to convert many to [[Azuth]]'s faith.<ref>{{Cite book/Prayers from the Faithful|111}}</ref>
* Members of non-dragon humanoid races begin to hear the call of Bahamut, and many of undergo the ''Rite of Rebirth'', transforming themselves into [[dragonborn of Bahamut]].<ref name="DoF3">{{Cite book/Dragons of Faerûn|9}}</ref>
* At the direction of Lady [[Merelith]], a new lighthouse is built on [[Mezeketh Isle]] off the coast of [[Saerloon]] and [[Zembrath Klun]] is put in charge.<ref name="FaP-163">{{Cite book/Faiths and Pantheons|163}}</ref>
* This year is known as the Year of the Carnival in the [[Black Chronology]].<ref name="C.TotW-159">{{Cite book/Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave|159}}</ref><ref name="TGHotR-157">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|157}}</ref>
* ''[[A Small but Treasonous Chapbook]]'', a book written by [[Albaertin]] of [[Marsember]], is published.<ref name="TCC">{{Cite web/The Candlekeep Collection}}</ref>
* ''[[The Falling Feather: Romance and Passion among Modern Noble Lasses]]'', a book written by an unknown author, is published.<ref name="TCC" />
* The three volume ''[[Notes on Serôs]]'', written by [[Ondam Moray]] of [[Dilpur]], is published.<ref name="TCC" />

{{Yearbox/in-environment}}
* [[Mount Ugruth]] experiences minor volcanic activity and makes some slight rumbling. This is enough to briefly open a ''[[portal]]'' to the [[Elemental Plane of Fire]], through dozens of [[magmin]]s escape into the volcano's chamber.<ref name="GHotR-p144" />

{{Yearbox/in-environment}}
* A magically triggered volcanic eruption buries under magma the city of [[Solon]] in the [[Semphâr]]i section of the [[Raurin]] Desert.<ref name="tGHotR-p146">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|146}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-conflicts}}
* [[Mirtul 3]]: The [[red dragon]] [[Klauth]] is waylaid by a pair of [[white dragon]]s and the [[blue dragon]], [[Irdrithkryn]], working in concert to kill him. Although Klauth slays each of his attackers and plunders Irdrithkryn's lair, he is gravely wounded, almost losing a wing and having half his body frozen solid.<ref name="D244.WotN.K">{{Cite dragon/244/Wyrms of the North: Klauth}}</ref>
* A great number of mercenaries leave [[Tethyr]] and join King [[Azoun IV]] of [[Cormyr]]'s crusade against the [[Tuigan Horde]].<ref name="tGHotR-p144">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|144}}</ref>
* [[Zhentil Keep]] contributes an [[orc]] army to Azoun's crusade, and they journey to [[Thesk]] to meet him.<ref name="tGHotR-p144"/>
* The [[Thay]]an army south of [[Lake Mulsantir]] is stuck in winter snows, freeing the [[Rashemi]] berserkers to move north and launch a surprise attack on the [[Tuigan]] camps. The [[Battle of the Lake of Tears]] force the Tuigans into retreat, but the Rashemi do not follow as the [[Red Wizards of Thay]] part the water of [[Lake Ashane]] so the Tuigans may cross.<ref name="tGHotR-p144"/>
* Following the defeat in Rashemen, [[Yamun Khahan]] directs the Tuigan Horde westward along the [[Golden Way]]. [[Faerûn]]ian nations rally to the [[Council of Thesk]].<ref name="tGHotR-p144"/>
* The Tuigan Horde invading [[Thesk]] is defeated at [[Phsant]] by a united army led by Azoun IV.<ref name="tGHotR-p144"/><ref>{{Cite book/Forgotten_Realms_Campaign_Guide|182}}</ref>
* The [[Harper]] [[Lander]] and the witch [[Ruha]] greatly disrupt [[Zhentarim]] caravans in the [[Anauroch]].<ref name="tGHotR-p145">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|145}}</ref>
* The [[lich]] [[Tan Chin]], formerly an Emperor of [[Shou Lung]], raises an [[undead]] army from the ruins of Solon. With powerful [[Imaskari]] magic, he then masquerades as the Raja [[Ambuchar Devayam]] and conquers [[Ra-Khati]] and several settlements in the [[Katakoro Plateau]].<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* The [[necromancer]] [[Kelshara]] steals the [[Tear of Everard]] from [[Everard Abbey]]. The warrior-turned-priest [[Tyveris]] recovers it after defeating her.<ref name="RoV-KT">{{Cite book/Realms of Valor/King's Tear}}</ref>
* [[Adon]] and [[Corene]], both priests of [[Mystra]], travel to the cursed town of [[Tegea]] at the urging of their goddess. Despite discovering that Duke [[Gorgias]] had laid a ward upon the town making it difficult for clerics' prayers to reach the divine realms, they manage to defeat him. With the ward mostly broken, Adon opens a temple to Mystra.<ref name="RoV-TCoT">{{Cite book/Realms of Valor/The Curse of Tegea}}</ref>
* [[Abet-Khrul]] leads a fleet of twenty four galleys full of pirates against the [[Golden Legion]]. Captain [[Cordell]] is victorious, and the pirate's defeat ensures [[Asavir's Channel]] is safe for merchant traffic for years to come.<ref>{{Cite dragon/362/Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes|29}}</ref>
* [[Akanna]], [[priest]]ess of [[Cyric]],  kills [[Bhaalist]]s and seizes their [[Temple of Bhaal (Forest of Wyrms)|temple]] in the [[Forest of Wyrms]] for her deity's cult.<ref name="BGs">{{Cite game/Baldur's Gate: Siege of Dragonspear}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-deities}}
* [[Talona]] commands [[Castle Trinity]] in [[Erlkazar]] to begin its campaign of conquest.<ref name="tGHotR-p145"/>
* [[Talos]] begins a five year campaign of sending storms, drought, and worse weather against the [[Moonshae Isles]].<ref name="Dr362-GHotR">{{Cite dragon/362/Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes|29}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-people}}
* [[Alusair Obarskyr]] is reunited with her [[Azoun IV|father]].<ref name="Crusade-p131">{{Cite book/Crusade|131, 132}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/deaths}}
* Yamun Khahan of the Tuigan Horde dies in single combat against King Azoun IV of Cormyr.<ref name="tGHotR-p144"/>
* A series of murders shakes [[Arabel]]. Several prominent wizards and miscellaneous spell-caster are targeted by the [[Night Parade]]. [[Artos Malabar]], [[Epicot]], and [[Myschanta Halarra]] are slain. Myschanta is resurrected by [[Alustriel Silverhand]] several days later. [[Zhentarim]] is blamed for the deaths.<ref name="dung">{{Cite dungeon/61/Storm Season|28-43}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/migrations}}
* A group of [[saurial]] [[slavery|slaves]] are taken to [[Tarkhaldale]] by the [[god]] [[Moander]]. They later break free and establish a settlement in the dale.<ref name="FRCG-p112">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide|112}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-Realmspace}}
* The [[Second Unhuman War]] spreads to [[Realmspace]] as a coalition between the [[Elven Imperial Fleet]] and the [[spelljammer]] fleet from [[Evermeet]] fights to repel a [[scro]] invasion over several battles.<ref name="DA1-p46">{{Cite dragon annual/1996/Campaign Classics: The Scro|46}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/misc}}
* An ancient [[fang dragon]] named [[Nartheling]] moves into the mountain [[Umbergoth]] in [[Aglarond]].<ref name="tGHotR-p145"/>
* A gang of pirates briefly recovers [[Shanatar]]'s ''[[Wyrmskull Throne]]'' in the [[Bay of Skulls]] near [[Hook Isle]], but then lose it again.<ref name="tGHotR-p145"/>
* The ''[[Pasha's Palace]]'', a massive, steel-reinforced, magically warded warship intended to be the terror of the seas is sunk five hours into its maiden voyage by a [[kraken]].<ref>{{Cite book/Empires of the Shining Sea|89}}</ref>
* The ''[[Wyvern Crown]]'' of [[Cormyr]] is stolen by [[Zhent]] agents led by the famed thief [[Asbarode|Nith]]. He loses it in a region of [[wild magic]] in the [[Helmlands]].<ref>{{Cite book/Volo's Guide to All Things Magical|122}}</ref>
* One night in summer, a woman, clad in nothing but a falcon-head carnival mask, is observed walking from the [[City of the Dead]] in [[Waterdeep]] to that city’s south gate holding high what appears to be the real ''[[Silver Supplicant]]'' when only fakes have been seen for the last 200 years.<ref>{{Cite book/Prayers from the Faithful|86}}</ref>
* This year is known as the Year of Armies in the [[Black Chronology]].<ref name="C.TotW-159">{{Cite book/Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave|159}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-p157">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|157}}</ref>
* Zhentarim wizard [[Pontifel]] is targeted by the Night Parade. To save his life, he agrees to remove all Black Network operations from Arabel for a decade. The agreement is signed and delivered to King [[Azoun Obarskyr IV]].<ref name="dung" />
* The Night Parade kick off a plot to open a ''[[gate]]'' into the [[Demiplane of Nightmares]] to conquer Arabel and assassinate [[Myrmeen Lhal]] and her adopted daughter [[Krystin Lhal|Krystin]]. The plot is stopped by a group of adventurers and several members of the Night Parade are slain.<ref name="dung" />

1361 DR:
__NOTOC__
{{Roll of years|1361|Maidens}}

{{Yearbox
|year=1361
|age=Era of Upheaval}}
{{LunarCalendarBox}}

{{Yearbox/in-deities}}
* [[Lolth]] sends a [[yochlol]] to [[Menzoberranzan]] during a sacrifice of a [[drow]] male. The handmaiden decrees the new laws of the Spider Queen. There should be peace among all houses, no drow must be sacrificed, even males and children should be treated well. All this is to strengthen the city after the turmoil and losses of the recent past. Until Lolth declares the end of this peace, every house that breaks these rules will be punished by her. The yochlol also named the new twenty strongest houses of the city.<ref name="DoD-196">{{Cite book/Daughter of the Drow/MMP|196-200}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* In the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]], [[Teldar]] becomes King of the Pirates.<ref name="SoFS-p7">{{Cite book/Sea of Fallen Stars|7}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-conflicts}}
* The followers of [[Cyric]] seize control of [[Zhentil Keep]].<ref name="MoM p.154">{{Cite book/Mysteries of the Moonsea|154}}</ref> [[Xeno Mirrormane]] leads an inquisition/holy war known as the [[First Banedeath]] in an effort to scour the city of the existing [[Bane]] worshipers. They given the option to worship Cyric or die.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* The [[Chosen]] of [[Eilistraee]] from the [[Promenade of the Dark Maiden|Promenade]] has skirmishes with and attacks the [[Dragon's Hoard]] merchant company's headquarters in [[Skullport]].<ref name="Sk-17">{{Cite book/Skullport|17}}</ref>
* [[Castle Trinity]], led by [[Barjin]] and later [[Aballister Bonaduce]], begins their quest for regional conquest.<ref name="iSS">{{Cite book/In Sylvan Shadows}}</ref>
* [[Luskan]] conquers [[Ruathym]] again, but the [[Lords' Alliance]] threatens war and forces a withdrawal.<ref name="FRCS3e-p176">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|176}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-p146">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|146}}</ref>
* [[Cordell]]'s [[Golden Legion]] conquers [[Payit]], [[Kultaka]], and [[Nexal]] in [[Maztica]].<ref name="Ironhelm">{{Cite book/Ironhelm}}</ref><ref name="Viperhand">{{Cite book/Viperhand}}</ref> They take over the city of [[Ulatos]].<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* Four archmages of the [[Cult of the Dragon]] come to [[Silverymoon]] and hurl spells to provoke [[Alustriel Silverhand]] to confront them. Alustriel and [[Taern Hornblade|Taern "Thunderspell" Hornblade]] destroy two of the archmages, but a Cult [[dracolich]] then assaults the southern walls. Taern and the [[Spellguard]] deal with the dracolich, leaving Alustriel to face the remaining archmages alone. She slays one, but only the fortuitous arrival of [[Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun]] and [[Laeral Silverhand]] save her life against the last.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/><ref name="DoF-p53">{{Cite book/Dragons of Faerûn|53}}</ref>
* [[Tammar]] in [[Thesk]] is seized by [[Tuigan]] bandits, who harass merchants on the [[Golden Way]] for months.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* [[Tan Chin]] leads his undead forces into [[Shou Lung]]. Still weak from the [[Tuigan Horde]] two years before, the Shou are overrun at [[Shih Tuh]] and [[Yenching]]. Tan Chin then takes [[Lo Tu]], then the whole realm of [[Khazari]] by the end of the year.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>

{{Yearbox/migrations}}
* The continent of [[Maztica]] is discovered by [[Amn]]ian explorer Captain-General [[Cordell]] and the [[Golden Legion]].<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/><ref name="MCS-j-p33">{{Cite book/Maztica Campaign Set/A Journey to the True World|33}}</ref>
* [[Helmsport]] is founded by the Golden Legion in Maztica.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>

{{Yearbox/in-organizations}}
* Following the Cyricist takeover of Zhentil Keep,<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/> [[Manshoon]] makes the [[Citadel of the Raven]] the new headquarters for the [[Zhentarim]].<ref name="MoM p.154">{{Cite book/Mysteries of the Moonsea|154}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* The [[Monastery of St Domin]] is dedicated to [[Ilmater]] in [[Tethyr]], about a half-day north of where the path from Mosstone ended at the coast.<ref>{{Cite book/Volo's Guide to Baldur's Gate II|99}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/deaths}}
* [[Barjin]], the cleric of [[Talona]], plans to destroy the [[Edificant Library]], but is killed by [[Cadderly Bonaduce]].<ref>{{Cite book/Canticle}}</ref>
* [[Ragnor]], a half-[[ogre]] from [[Castle Trinity]], is killed by [[Elbereth]] and [[Cadderly Bonaduce]].<ref name="iSS"/>
* The assassin [[Ghost (assassin)|Ghost]] of [[Westgate]], is defeated by Cadderly Bonaduce. He is officially defeated in a mental battle with Cadderly in some abyssal rift.<ref name="iSS"/>
* [[Galladel]], an elven king of [[Shilmista]], is killed during the invasion by Castle Trinity's forces. His son, [[Elbereth]], becomes the new king.<ref name="iSS"/>
* [[Bogo Rath]], one of the three wizards of Castle Trinity, is killed by [[Ivan Bouldershoulder]] after a failed attempt to escape from Cadderly Bonaduce when his assassination plans fall to pieces.
* [[Zz'Pzora]], a two-headed [[deep dragon]], is killed in the lair of the [[Dragon's Hoard]] merchant company beneath [[Skullport]].<ref name="DotD.K-loc5392>{{Cite digital book/Daughter of the Drow/Kindle|5392}}</ref>
* [[Naltecona]], the last ruler of [[Nexal]], is killed by Cordell's mage and lover [[Darien]], setting off the [[Night of Wailing]].<ref name="Viperhand"/>
* The [[Amn]]nian Bishop of [[Helm]], [[Domincus]] is sacrificed to the [[Maztica]]n god [[Zaltec]] in [[Nexal]].<ref name="Viperhand"/>
* [[Cordell]]'s cavalry commander [[Alvarro]] is poisoned when he attempts to rape a priestess of [[Qotal]].<ref name="Viperhand"/>
* The wizard [[Xonthal]] dies from unknown means.<ref name="tRoT-p62">{{Cite book/The Rise of Tiamat|62}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-people}}
* After convincing the [[Krollir Venasten|Righteous Man]], guildmaster of the [[Night Knives]]' thieves' guild of [[Selgaunt]], to have guild members infiltrate the homes of several noble families in order to gain actionable information, [[Erevis Cale]] assassinates the butler of the [[Uskevren]] family and then convinces [[Thamalon Uskevren]] to hire him as the man's replacement.<ref name="THoS">{{Cite book/The Halls of Stormweather}}</ref>
* A former [[Sembia]]n nobleman named [[Dinam]] becomes a [[dukar]] after falling overboard from his ship and losing his memory.<ref name="WT-p6-7">{{Cite book/Wyrmskull Throne|6-7}}</ref>
* [[Arilyn Moonblade]] and [[Danilo Thann]] discover that the [[Harper Assassin]] terrorizing the [[North]] is the [[gold elf]] [[Kymil Nimesin]]. Danilo joins the [[Harpers]].<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>

{{Yearbox/in-Realmspace}}
* The [[hammership]] ''[[Probe]]'' docks in [[Rauthaven]] in [[Nimbral]] for an auction.<ref name="ItV">{{Cite book/Into the Void}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/misc}}
* This year is known as the Year of the Golden Discovery in the [[Black Chronology]].<ref name="C.TotW-159">{{Cite book/Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave|159}}</ref><ref name="TGHotR-157">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|157}}</ref>

1362 DR:
__NOTOC__
{{Roll of years|1362|the Helm}}

{{Yearbox
|year=1362
|age=Era of Upheaval}}
{{LunarCalendarBox}}

{{Yearbox/in-deities}}
* The [[Maztica]]n god [[Zaltec]] manifests in the form of a giant stone statue. He leads an army of [[orc]]s and [[ogre]]s to the [[Twin Visages]] and then later battles the [[avatar]] of [[Qotal]]. When it appears that the gods' battle would destroy Maztica, both avatars are banished back to the outer planes by the high priest of Qotal.<ref name="Feathered Dragon">{{Cite book/Feathered Dragon}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-conflicts}}
* [[Mintar]] is conquered by [[Teldorn Darkhope]] and the [[Church of Bane]].<ref>{{Cite dungeon/69/Sleep of Ages}}</ref>
* An [[assassin]] of the highest order is sent from the [[School of Stealth]] to stop [[Arilyn Moonblade]] and [[Danilo Thann]] from warning [[Pasha]] [[Balik]] of a plan to overthrow him.<ref name="RoV-TB">{{Cite book/Realms of Valor/The Bargain}}</ref>
* A mixed army of native [[Maztica]]ns, [[desert dwarves]], [[wild halfling]]s, and members of the [[Golden Legion]] defeats an army of orcs and ogres in the second battle of [[Ulatos]].<ref name="Feathered Dragon">{{Cite book/Feathered Dragon}}</ref>
* The presence of the [[elder brain]] of [[Ch'Chitl]] is discovered on the [[Astral Plane]] by [[githyanki]] explorers and attacked, forcing it to shift entirely to the [[Prime Material Plane]]. [[Thalynsar]], the only [[ulitharid]] in the city, absorbs its accumulated knowledge and powers with the aid of a group of [[alhoon]] [[necromancer]]s, transforming him into an [[ulitharilich]].<ref name="DDGttUD-p44">{{Cite book/Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark|44}}</ref>{{Ch'Chitl-event}}
* [[Thay]] launches an invasion of [[Rashemen]] via [[Thesk]] and the [[Golden Way]]. The [[Witches of Rashemen]] summon [[water elemental]]s that wipe out the Thayan force. The Thayans retreat, but literally scorch the earth down to bare rock around the western shore of Rashemen.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* Deciding to deal with [[Tuigan]] bandits lingering after the [[Tuigan Horde]], the [[Merchants' Council]] of Phsant sends 100 [[orc]] warriors left behind by the [[Zhentarim]] during the [[Crusade]] against the Horde. The savage orcs hunt down and kill every one of the Tuigan.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>

{{Yearbox/in-environment}}
* The Witches work to repair the damage inflicted by the Thayans on the western shore of Rashemen.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>

{{Yearbox/migrations}}
* Refugees from [[Nexal]] establish the city of [[Tukan]] in the [[House of Tezca]] desert.<ref name="Feathered Dragon">{{Cite book/Feathered Dragon}}</ref>
* In Maztica, [[tlincalli]] Divivers begin a complicated a mass ritual with the intention of teleporting as many warriors as possible to [[Faerûn]]. The ritual is completed [[1365 DR|three years]] later.<ref name="U-p165">{{Cite book/Underdark|165}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* Using spoils of war from the [[Tuigan War]], [[Zaranda Star]]<ref name="WiT-c2">{{Cite book/War in Tethyr|chapter=2}}</ref> purchases [[County Morninggold]] and [[Morninggold Keep|its keep]] from the [[Order of the Silver Chalice]] to help fund their operations in restoring nobility in the land.<ref name="LoI1-T-p88">{{Cite book/Lands of Intrigue/Tethyr|88}}</ref>{{Countess Morninggold dates}}

{{Yearbox/misc}}
* The [[Rotting Man]], a servant of [[Talona]], appears in the [[Rawlinswood]].<ref>{{Cite book/Unapproachable East|122}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* At the request of the [[illusionist]] [[Drollo]], [[Galvin]] tracks down the old mage's great-granddaughter, [[Isabelle]], whom he finds deep in the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]] in a [[sea elf|sea elven]] contraption known as a mechanical [[water spider]].<ref name="RoV-GT">{{Cite book/Realms of Valor/Grandfather's Toys}}</ref>
* The sage [[Koja]] plans to publish his history of the [[Tuigan]] war with [[Cormyr]], titled ''[[A History of the Tuigan]]''.<ref name="RoV-Patronage">{{Cite book/Realms of Valor/Patronage}}</ref>
* This year is known as the Year of the Sun in the [[Black Chronology]].<ref name="C.TotW-159">{{Cite book/Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave|159}}</ref><ref name="TGHotR-157">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|157}}</ref>
* Priests of [[Helm]] across the [[Southwest Faerûn|South]] proclaim the year heralds the start of blessed works for his faithful.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* The [[Edificant Library]] in [[Erlkazar]] is destroyed, but construction begins on its replacement, the [[Spirit Soaring]] cathedral.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* An adventuring band led by [[Francis the All-Seeing]] banished the [[ghost]]s of two young children who were killed and buried under the street of the [[Neverwinter/Protector's Enclave|Merchant Quarter]] of [[Neverwinter]].<ref name="nwn2">{{Cite game/Neverwinter Nights 2}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-organizations}}
* The [[Church of Bane|Banite]] temples that will soon be known as the [[Twin Towers of the Eternal Eclipse]] are taken by [[Church of Cyric|Cyricists]] and reconsecrated.<ref name="Lod-p12">{{Cite book/Lords of Darkness|12}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* The [[Council of Six]] of [[Amn]] is wracked by the [[Council Schism]]. [[Thayze Selemchant]], Meisarch of Amn, dies and is replaced by the new Meisarch, [[Erlranther Alibakkar]]. [[Phaan Colwyvv]] is the new Tessarch, [[Qar Jysstev]] the new Namarch, [[Rhinnom Dannihyr]] the new Iltarch, [[Tyrda Q'Helvor]] the new Pommarch, and [[Pehllus Tanislove]] the new Dahaunarch.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/><ref name="LoIA-p8">{{Cite book/Lands of Intrigue/Amn|8}}</ref>
* As Selemchant was an ally of [[Syl-Pasha]] [[Ralan el Pesarkhal]] of [[Calimshan]], Ralan's plans to conquer [[Tethyr]] are put on hold.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* [[Maligor]], the [[Zulkir]] of [[Alteration]] of the [[Red Wizards]], tries to seize control of [[Thay]] from the [[Council of Zulkirs]] by taking over the country's gold production. [[Harper]] agents and [[Szass Tam]], Zulkir of [[Necromancy]], intervene and foil Maligor's scheme.<ref name="tGHotR-p146">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|146}}</ref>
* The colony of [[Helmsport]] is named the capital of [[New Amn]].<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* [[Bruenor Battlehammer]] abdicates as Eighth King of [[Mithral Hall]], leaving the throne to the restored [[Gandalug Battlehammer]], now both First King and Ninth King.<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>

{{Yearbox/deaths}}
* [[Tan Chin]] is slain by adventurers wielding the ''[[Stone Scepter of Shih]]'', in the catacombs under [[Skarou]].<ref name="tGHotR-p146"/>
* [[Aballister Bonaduce]] is killed by his son, [[Cadderly Bonaduce]]. [[Castle Trinity]] is abandoned.<ref>{{Cite book/The Fallen Fortress}}</ref>
* The [[drider]] [[Darien]] is killed by the high priest of [[Qotal]].<ref name="Feathered Dragon">{{Cite book/Feathered Dragon}}</ref>
* [[Willeth Lionson]], the tharchion of Thaymount and [[Thayvian gold mines]] was tortured to death by [[Maligor]] and fed to the zulkir's gnolls.<ref name="RM-p96">{{Cite book/Red Magic|96}}</ref>
* [[Maligor]], the Zulkir of Alteration in Thay perished in the [[Thayvian gold mines]]' collapsed tunnels after a failed attempt to take over Thay's economy.<ref name="VL-p44">{{Cite book/Villains' Lorebook|44}}</ref>
* [[Rodolpho Wianar]], a cousin of [[Eles Wianar]], the Lord of [[Arrabar]], is killed by a [[crossbow]] [[bolt]]. The masked assassin flees the scene of the crime and is never captured. Not so coincidentally, [[Xaphira Matrell]] mysteriously disappears and is presumed dead.<ref name="tAT-p6–7">{{Cite book/The Sapphire Crescent|6–7}}</ref><ref name="TSC-fam">{{Cite book/The Sapphire Crescent/House Matrell Family Tree}}</ref>
* [[Xakamt]], a [[beholder]], is slain while attempting to invade the [[Flaming Brazier]] temple in [[Bezantur]]. However, it persists as a flaming [[doomsphere]] bound to serve the temple's high priest, [[Mythalanir]].<ref name="P&P-p150">{{Cite book/Powers & Pantheons|150}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-people}}
*[[Seldig]], a young [[Blingdenstone]] [[svirfneblin]], is given the responsibilities of a burrow warden.<ref name="DDGttUD-p 38">{{Cite book/Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark|38}}</ref>
*The [[great wyrm]] [[blue dragon]] [[Iryklathagra]] moves into the chapter house of the [[Skeletal Finger]] thieves' [[guild]] beneath the [[Small Teeth]] mountains. Once a trap-filled fortification, she renovates her new lair to be impregnable.<ref name="tGHotR-p146" />

{{Yearbox/in-Realmspace}}

*[[Teldin Moore]] of [[Krynn]] becomes one of only a handful of [[human]]s to visit [[Evermeet]].<ref name="TRD-c8">{{Cite book/The Radiant Dragon|chapter=8}}</ref>

1363 DR:
{{Roll of years|1363|the Wyvern}}

{{Yearbox
| age  = Era of Upheaval
| year = 1363
}}
{{LunarCalendarBox}}

{{Yearbox/in-conflicts}}
* [[Devil]]s emerge from ''[[portal]]''s in [[Dragonspear Castle]] and gather an army of [[ogre]]s, [[kobold]]s, [[orc]]s, all kinds of [[goblinoid]]s, and a black dragon. In the [[Second Dragonspear War]], the [[Hordes of Dragonspear (army)|Hordes of Dragonspear]] overrun and destroy the village of [[Way Inn]] and its namesake, before moving to attack [[Daggerford]]. The Hordes are defeated in the [[Battle of Daggerford]] by a hastily made alliance of [[Dwarf|dwarves]], [[Elf|elves]] from the [[Misty Forest]], [[paladin]]s of [[Ilmater]], mercenaries, local militia, and a troop of the [[City Guard (Waterdeep)|City Guard]] of [[Waterdeep]].<ref name="GHR-146">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|146}}</ref>
* [[Ruathym]] defeats a [[Merrow (ogre)|merrow]] army sent to conquer it by the [[illithid]] [[Vestress]], servant of [[Slarkrethel]].<ref name="TNW-42">{{Cite book/The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier/The Wilderness|42}}</ref>
* [[Teldar]], master of the pirates of the [[Inner Sea]], is challenged and defeated by his main rival, [[Vurgrom|Vurgrom "the Mighty"]]. Teldar is exiled to [[Thesk]] as Vurgrom take control of the pirates.<ref name="GHR-146"/>
* The [[Edificant Library]] is attacked by [[Kierkan Rufo]], reinforced by the [[Chaos Curse]]. All its inhabitants die or turn into vampires. Soon, the Edificant Library is destroyed by [[Cadderly]], and [[Spirit Soaring]] is built in its place.<ref name="tCC-p??">{{Cite book/The Chaos Curse}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-people}}
* [[Artus Cimber]] finds the [[Ring of Winter (artifact)|''Ring of Winter'']] in the temple of [[Ubtao]] in the reappeared city of [[Mezro]] in the jungles of [[Chult]].<ref name="GHR-146"/><ref name="VGtaTM-p112">{{Cite book/Volo's Guide to All Things Magical|112}}</ref> He uses it to help defeat an army of [[goblin]]s led by the [[Cult of Frost]], who were attacking Mezro in order to capture the Ring.<ref name="VGtaTM-p112">{{Cite book/Volo's Guide to All Things Magical|112}}</ref>
* A refugee cracks (but doesn’t break) the great seal of [[Deep Imaskar]] to allow limited numbers of people in and out of the city.<ref name="frcg4e-p138">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide|138}}</ref>
* The famed explorer [[Alkazaar]] arrives in [[Candlekeep]] to tell tales of his exploits and to donate two books about them to the library: ''[[Alkazaar's Thrilling Tales]]'' and ''[[Alkazaar's Appendix]]''.<ref name="CM-p198">{{Cite book/Candlekeep Mysteries/Alkazaar's Appendix|198}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* Following the disappearance of Lord [[Bron]] in mid-Hammer, [[Iriaebor]] is taken over by the [[Zhentarim]], who install Lord [[Cutter (person)|Cutter]] as their puppet in mid-[[Hammer (month|Hammer]]. Cutter's rule is harsh and unstable and Iriaebor is later reclaimed by adventurers by mid-[[Marpenoth]]. Bron returns to power.<ref name="GHR-146"/>
* King [[Imphras V]], member of the [[Heltharn]] dynasty, dies of a wasting disease before he can actually claim the throne of [[Impiltur]]. [[Imbrar II]] succeeds him, a younger brother aged only 5. Thus [[Sambryl]] remains in power as Queen-Regent.<ref name="GHR-146"/><ref name="GHR-80">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|80}}</ref>
* The town of [[Tammar]] in Thesk is resettled and rebuilt following its destruction by the [[Tuigan Horde]] and occupation by bandits. The government paid a force of 100 [[orc]]s to drive out the bandits, and the orcs are hailed as heroes by the returning inhabitants and welcomed into the community.<ref name="GHR-146"/><ref name="FRCS3e-p209">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|209}}</ref>
* [[Hubadai Khahan|Hubadai]], the son of [[Yamun Khahan]] of the [[Tuigan Horde]] names himself [[khahan]] and establishes the [[Tuigan]] nation of [[Yaïmmunahar]].<ref name="GHR-146"/>

{{Yearbox/in-migrations}}
* With [[Rashemen]] experiencing an unusually cold winter, a great many creatures of cold from the [[Icerim Mountains]] journey into the [[North Country]] and further south.<ref name="GHR-146"/>

{{Yearbox/in-organizations}}
* [[Colin O'Lyre]] is named the Guildmaster of the [[Fellowship of Bards, Performers and Artists]] in [[Ravens Bluff]].<ref name="poly147-p23">{{Cite polyhedron/147/Pillars of Ravens Bluff|23}}</ref>
* [[Quinan Varnaed]], a priest of [[Loviatar]], and [[Zstulkk Ssarmn]], a [[yuan-ti]] [[yuan-ti abomination|abomination]], found the [[Iron Ring]] slaving consortium in [[Skullport]].<ref name="GHR-146"/>

{{Yearbox/births}}

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* In [[Waterdeep]], droughts, increased monster activity, and political unrest plague the city in the months before [[Midsummer]]. A [[green dragon]] named [[Grimnoshtadrano]], the Riddling Dragon of the [[High Forest]], and a mad [[bard]] and ex-[[Harper]] named [[Iriador Wintermist|Iriador "Garnet" Wintermist]] disrupt [[Shieldmeet]], which nearly upsets the [[Lords of Waterdeep|Lord's]] Rule.<ref name="CoS.W">{{Cite book/City of Splendors: Waterdeep}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-146"/>
* Lord [[Uthrain]] of the [[Great Dale]] is killed in what is believed to be a hunting accident. Lord [[Uthlain]] inherits the throne after his father. Although the death is initially blamed on [[ranger]]s in the [[Forest of Lethyr]], a band of adventurers discovers the real killers to be agents of the [[Shadowmasters of Telflamm]], who were working to destabilize [[Uthmere]].<ref name="UE-122">{{Cite book/Unapproachable East|122}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-146"/>
* [[Telflamm]] is occupied by the [[Sharkjaws]], a pirate fleet commanded by [[Evgruth|Evgruth the Red]]. Evgruth extorts huge sums from the merchant's council to spare Telflamm's trade.<ref name="tGHotR-146"/>

{{Yearbox/in-organizations}}
* The [[Cult of the Dragon]] cell in Sembia increases hostilities against the [[Zhentarim]], by raiding caravans and trying to seize control of a number of trade routes.<ref name="tGHotR-146">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|146–147}}</ref>
* [[Pasha]] [[Balik]] is assassinated in his bed by an agent of the [[Knights of the Shield]].<ref name="tGHotR-146"/><ref name="C-24">{{Cite book/Calimport|24}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-people}}
* [[Wulfgar]], long held captive by the [[demon]] [[Errtu]] and thought dead by his friends, is released from the [[Abyss]] and returned to [[Faerûn]]. He rejoins the [[Companions of the Hall]], and they banish Errtu from the world and back to the Abyss again.<ref name="tGHotR-146"/>
* The Companions journey to [[Spirit Soaring]] hoping that [[Cadderly]] might be able to finally destroy ''[[Crenshinibon]]'', the Crystal Shard.<ref name="tGHotR-146"/>
* The evil power of the [[Shadowstar]] corrupts [[Caledan Caldorien]], a [[Harper]], and begins to transform him into the [[Shadowking]]. Caledan releases three [[shadevari]] servants. His former adventuring companions destroy the creatures, save Caledan, and prevent the Shadowking's return.<ref name="tGHotR-146"/>
* The [[Masked Lady]] of [[Selgaunt]], a mysterious socialite who has never shown her face in nine years of living there, foils an attempted robbery on her person during a party. She is shot at when her mask is removed and all assembled think her (incorrectly) to be a [[mind flayer]]. She survives the attack and jumps off a balcony, never to be seen again. Her true species is debated for years to come.<ref name="PftF-55">{{Cite book/Prayers from the Faithful|55}}</ref>
* The husband of [[Selantha]] mysteriously vanishes during a trading mission.<ref name="SP-p57">{{Cite book/Skullport|57}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-migrations}}
* [[Amn]] establishes a second colony further inland in [[Maztica]], named [[Qoral]] after an old native town nearby. Their purpose is to develop trade between [[New Amn]] and the natives of the west.<ref name="tGHotR-146"/>
* The first ships from [[Faerûn]] not from [[Amn]] dock at [[Helmsport]] in Maztica.<ref name="tGHotR-146"/>
* Failed explorations and attacks by [[wild elves]] reduce the number of [[Flaming Fist]] mercenaries in Helmsport by two-thirds. The Flaming Fist later builds [[Fort Flame]] north of Kultaka, but it remains under siege.<ref name="tGHotR-146"/>

{{Yearbox/in-conflicts}}
* [[Borlin]] of the [[Iron House]] inspires a large number of [[dwarf|dwarven]] warriors to form the [[Mithril Legion]] and embark on a quest to reclaim the lost [[Mines of Tethyamar]], near the Dalelands. They march out of [[Tilverton]], travel north-west, but are not heard from again. In fact, their assault is successful, but the army is lost and wiped out.<ref name="SLp90">{{Cite dragon/Soargar's Legacy|90}}</ref><ref name="LEoF">{{Cite book/Lost Empires of Faerun|135}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-146"/>
* The sultan of [[Hafayah]] is poisoned. In the following bloody conflict most of his children are killed, too, leaving under-age [[Saba|Prince Saba]] as ruler, with Father [[Uqban min Najm]] acting as regent.{{AQ-time}}<ref>{{Cite book/Land of Fate/Adventurer's Guide to Zakhara|71-72}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/misc}}
* The sage [[Terithus]] of [[Athkatla]] publishes the chapbook ''[[Red Her Valor]]'', about the heroics of the [[Red Knight]] as a mortal during the [[Time of Troubles]].<ref name="TGHotR-143">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|143}}</ref>
* [[Claddart]] of [[Candlekeep]] publishes "[[Things I Have Observed]]".<ref name="ToE-117">{{Cite book/The Temptation of Elminster/Paperback 1999|117|4}}</ref>
* Recognizing the Masked Lady of Selgaunt’s mask to be the ''[[Mask of Mysteries]]'', the [[Asannath|family]] of its [[Rellogur Asannath|previous owner]] offers a 100,000 [[gold piece]] reward for its return but within a month it is on sale in [[Scornubel]] and the focal point of several fights between [[Mask]]arran thieves. It is eventually lost.<ref name="PftF-55"/>
* This year is known as the Year of Lords in the [[Black Chronology]].<ref name="C.TotW-159">{{Cite book/Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave|159}}</ref><ref name="TGHotR-157">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|157}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/births}}
* Twins [[Quindy Matrell|Quindy]] and [[Obiron Matrell II]] of noble merchant [[House Matrell]] are born in [[Arrabar]] on [[Tarsakh 13]].<ref name="TSC-fam">{{Cite book/The Sapphire Crescent/House Matrell Family Tree}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-conflicts}}
* [[Thay]] invades [[Aglarond]]. One Thayan army advances on the fortress of [[Emmech]], while a second heads south to the [[Shyvar Pass]]. Aglarondan troops from [[Glarondar]] engage the southern force and repel them. They then pass through the [[Tannath Gap]], attack the Thayans at Emmech from the rear.<ref name="UE-p105">{{Cite book/Unapproachable East|105}}</ref><ref name="TGHotR-147">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|147}}</ref>
* Thay later invades [[Rashemen]], entering from the east. While the [[Witches of Rashemen]] deal with flooding caused by [[Red Wizards of Thay]], the Thayan forces cross the foothills of the [[High Country (Rashemen)|High Country]]. They are repelled by angered [[elemental]]s.<ref name="TGHotR-147"/>
* [[Alasklerbanbastos]], the Great Bone Wyrm, together with his [[chromatic dragon]] followers, seize control over parts of [[Chessenta]]: [[Mordulkin]], [[Mount Thulbane]], [[Thamor]], [[Threskel]], and the [[Watcher's Cape]].<ref name="TGHotR-147"/>
*Town of [[Priapurl]] becomes besieged by a one-[[orc]] army [[Slogg Ogrum]] who managed to to almost bring the town to its knees  if not for the [[Mindulgulph Mercenary Company]], who eventually slew the threat. The resons behind the orc's attack remained a mystery.<ref name="nwn2">{{Cite game/Neverwinter Nights 2: Mysteries of Westgate}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/deaths}}
*[[Currag Blackstone]], son and heir to [[Angus Blackstone]], dies in mysterious circumstances, apparently falling 40 feet (12.2 meters).<ref name="PoM-p11">{{Cite book/Prophet of Moonshae|11}}</ref> His brother [[Gwyeth Blackstone]] is killed by the [[moorhound]] [[Warlock]] after Gwyeth tries to kill their other brother [[Hanrald Blackstone]]. Angus himself dies after having betrayed the throne to [[Church of Talos|Talassans]], killed by a spell cast by the [[Prophet of Talos]] that was intended for [[Deirdre Kendrick]].<ref>{{Cite book/Prophet of Moonshae}}</ref>
* [[Grintharke]], the [[balor]] ruler of Hellgate Keep, dies fighting seven [[Evereska]]n elves wielding the ''[[Shattering Swords of Coronal Ynloeth]]'' in his own gladiatorial arena. He manages to take down three of them with him, while the other four eventually die fighting the other demons in the keep, with at least one of them killing his [[vrock]] lieutenant. Many more demons would die that night through in-fighting, each wanting to assume control.<ref name="HG-p5-6, 8">{{Cite book/Hellgate Keep|5-6, 8}}</ref>
* [[Pawldo|Pawldo of Lowhill]], the [[halfling]] hero of the [[Moonshae Isles]].<ref name="Dr362-GHotR">{{Cite dragon/362/Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes|29}}</ref>
* [[Gotha]] the [[dracolich]], servant of [[Talos]], was defeated by Princess [[Alicia Kendrick]] of the [[Moonshae Isles]].<ref name="CoD-p53">{{Cite book/Cult of the Dragon|53}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-deities}}
* [[Lliira]], the Goddess of Joy,<ref name="FaA-96">{{Cite book/Faiths & Avatars|96}}</ref> sends a prophet to every temple of [[Waukeen]] announcing that she will act as regent for Waukeen's portfolio, listen to prayers, and grant spells to the worshipers of Waukeen until the Merchant's Friend returns.<ref name="FDaD-3">{{Cite book/For Duty & Deity|3}}</ref> Many of the Golden Lady's followers interpret this to mean their goddess is dead.<ref name="FaA-177">{{Cite book/Faiths & Avatars|177}}</ref>
* [[Talos]], god of destruction, attempts to replace worship of the [[Earthmother]] of the [[Moonshae Isles]] with that of the [[Faerûnian pantheon]].<ref name="TGHotR-147" />
* [[Malar]] sends the [[Ityak-Ortheel|Elf Eater]] against the realm of [[Synnoria]] through the Fey-Alamtine ''[[portal]]'', destroying the [[Llewyrr]] capital city of [[Chrysalis]]. It is eventually banished back to the [[Abyss]].<ref>{{Cite book/Prophet of Moonshae}}</ref>
*[[Selûne]] guides a group of adventurers calling themselves the [[Seekers]] to discover her artifact, the [[Tear of Selûne]], in [[Vaasa]]. Once they find it, she inexplicably withdraws her favor, and the members of the party are killed or captured by the [[Zhentarim]].<ref name="PGttFRC">{{Cite book/Player's Guide to the Forgotten Realms Campaign}}</ref>
* After the ''[[Silver-Hafted Axe]]'' is retrieved by [[firbolg]]s from the [[dwarf]] settlement of [[Cambro]], Dierdre Kendrick helps them free [[Grond Peaksmasher]] from his prison.<ref name="Dr362-GHotR" /> Rather than helping Dierdre's master Talos, Grond joins with the [[Earthmother]] against him.<ref>{{Cite polyhedron/111/Forgotten Deities: Grond Peaksmasher|4}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-environment}}
* Supporting their invasion of Rashemen, the Red Wizards of Thay melt glaciers in the [[Icerim Mountains]]. This leads to terrible flooding in [[Immilmar]] and [[Mulsantir]], which the Witches handle.<ref name="TGHotR-147"/>

{{Yearbox/in-migrations}}
* The Waterdhavians ships barred from Helmsport sail north, landing at [[Maztapan Island]]. From there, they found a colony called [[New Waterdeep]] near the [[Gulf of Kultaka]]. The Waterdhavian colonists negotiate and trade with the [[Kultakan]]s, to the irritation of New Amn's Governor-General [[Cordell]], as it limits New Amn's northern influence.<ref name="TGHotR-147" />
* Some of the Waterdhavian colonists from New Waterdeep continue north and build a second colony, [[Trythosford]], at the mouth of a river on the mainland due west of [[Zilhatec Island]].<ref name="TGHotR-147" />
* In [[Maztica]], [[Tlincalli]] [[diviner]]s create a ''[[gate]]'' and transport an expeditionary force of over a thousand of their people into the caves under [[Amn]]. The Tlincalli journey deeper into the [[Underdark]] and found the realm of [[Oaxapupta]] in the abandoned [[dwarf]] kingdom of [[Xothaerin]].<ref name="TGHotR-147" />

{{Yearbox/in-organizations}}
*The [[Cult of the Dragon]] cell of [[Sembia]] successfully persuades a [[blue dragon]] from the [[Anauroch]] named [[Malygris]] to become a [[dracolich]]. Once the process is complete, Malygris then battles and kills the ruler of Anauroch's loose association of blue dragons, before taking his place.<ref name="TGHotR-147" />

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* [[Waterdeep]] establishes limited trade with [[Maztica]] and [[Zakhara]] but, owing to the danger involved in the sea journeys, a lot of ships are lost.<ref name="CoS.CG-p31">{{Cite book/City of Splendors (boxed set)/Campaign Guide|31}}</ref> Twelve Waterdhavian ships arrive at [[Helmsport]] in [[Maztica]], but the Lord-Governor of [[New Amn]] bars them access, owing to the council's restrictions on transoceanic trade. Several of the ships journey north and establish colonies. At the end of the year, eight of the ships return to Waterdeep, but three sink on the voyage. The remainder carry fresh trade for the [[Sword Coast North]].<ref name="TGHotR-147"/>
* The [[marilith]]s [[Ssaarn]], [[Mulvassyss]], and [[Amassyra]] rise to power as the new rulers of [[Hellgate Keep]], forming a triumvirate.<ref name="TGHotR-147" /><ref name="HG-p6, 8">{{Cite book/Hellgate Keep|6, 8}}</ref>
* [[Alicia Kendrick]] is crowned as high queen of the Moonshae Isles after her father abdicates.<ref name="TGHotR-147" />
* The knight Hanrald Blackstone is named the new Earl of [[Fairheight]] to replace his traitorous father.<ref name="Dr362-GHotR" />

{{Yearbox/in-people}}
* Returning home from [[Amn]], [[Tristan Kendrick]]'s ship is lost with all hands. Tristan himself is captured by a [[scrag]] king named [[Krell-Bane]] and taken to [[Kyrasti]], the capital of the [[Coral Kingdom]], where his left hand is cut off and delivered to [[Robyn Kendrick|his wife]]. Tristan is eventually rescued but divine magic fails to restore his missing hand.<ref name="Dr362-GHotR" />
*[[Tsarra Chaadren]] becomes a senior apprentice of [[Blackstaff Tower]] after seven years there, and begins teaching other apprentices.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://ww2.wizards.com/books/mirrorstone/Article.aspx?doc=fr_blackstaffcp|title=Character Profile: Tsarra Chaadren|accessdate=2010-10-17|publisher=[[Wizards of the Coast]]}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/misc}}
*This year is known as the Year of Joyous Elves in the [[Black Chronology]].<ref name="C.TotW-159">{{Cite book/Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave|159}}</ref><ref name="TGHotR-157">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|157}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-conflicts}}
* [[Zaranda Star]] garners support from a number of cities and people of [[Tethyr]], leading to the beginning of the [[Reclamation Wars]].<ref name="tGHotR-147">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|147}}</ref>
