* [[Alturiak]]: A [[Red Wizard]] serving [[Dmitra Flass]] causes a minor rebellion against [[Thay]]ans in [[Mulmaster]]. Thayans are attacked and after a rumor spreads about the old temple to [[Waukeen]] being converted to Thayan worship of [[Kossuth]], an attempt is made to burn the building down. When city crossbowmen and [[wizard]]s fire upon the citizens involved, a riot erupts. Up to 1000 people are killed and a two month curfew is enacted.<ref name="RtR-p19" />
* [[Tarsakh]]: [[Drow]] attack the city of [[Assam]] and although they are successfully repelled, heavy losses are taken. Nearby realms prepare for a drow invasion.<ref name="RtR-p20">{{cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised)/Running the Realms|20}}</ref>
* [[Kythorn]]: [[Zhent]] woodcutters are attacked by [[satyr]]s and [[centaur]]s. The [[Zhentilar]] put the nonhumans down with minimal losses.<ref name="RtR-p21">{{cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised)/Running the Realms|21}}</ref>
* [[Eleasias]]: The settlements surrounding [[Schamedar]] rise up in rebellion against [[Shond Tharovin]]. The leaders of the small settlements around the city start calling themselves the Seven Satraps and vow to defeat Tharovin’s evil. Monsters, widely believed to have been summoned by Tharovin, begin raiding the area, keeping local adventurers busy.<ref name="RtR-p21" />
* [[Eleint]]: The four occupying forces of [[Scardale]] come into increasingly frequent conflict, mostly between the [[Cormyr]]eans and the [[Sembia]]ns, who are confined to their barracks by the [[Dalelands]] and Zhent troops.<ref name="RtR-p22">{{cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised)/Running the Realms|22}}</ref>
* [[Uktar]]: The orc horde of [[Greneire|King Greneire]] finally breaches the defenses of the [[Citadel Felbarr|Citadel of Many Arrows]]. Greneire's 150,000 are defeated by Obould's 40,000 and Obould slays Greneire in single combat.<ref name="SM-p6">{{Cite book/Silver Marches|6}}</ref>
* An allied army of [[Clan Warcrown]] [[dwarves]] and [[Silverymoon]] soldiers assault the orcs and seize back control of the Citadel of Many Arrows, restoring its name of [[Citadel Felbarr]].<ref name="tGHotR-147"/><ref name="SM-p6"/> They surprise the exhausted and battered orcs, driving them away from the Citadel. King Obould is not among the orc dead.<ref>{{Cite book/The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier/The Wilderness|10}}</ref>
* Schamedar is put under siege. The ''[[Living Gem]]'' bombards the assailants with magic and absorbs the life energies of anyone who tries to break it. Shond Tharovin is nowhere to be found.<ref name="RtR-p23">{{cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised)/Running the Realms|23}}</ref>
* Factions of rural-based priests of [[Bhaal]] who still venerate the dead god clash with factions of city-based priests who worship [[Iyachtu Xvim]] or [[Cyric]] above him. The fighting stops when the rural priests lose their divine magic and are forced to convert to one of the newer churches.<ref>{{Cite book/Faiths & Avatars|46}}</ref>
* A rogue pirate fleet led by the "Black Admiral" (actually [[Hlaavin]] of the [[Unseen]]) is destroyed when it attempts to cripple Waterdeep's trade fleet.<ref>{{Cite book/Cloak & Dagger|100}}</ref>
* Having gotten word of his longtime rival [[Grintharke]]'s demise, the mad wizard [[Radoc]] leads his monstrous army out of the [[Fallen Lands]] to assault [[Hellgate Keep]]. They are ultimately repelled by the fortress, leading to Radoc's death.<ref name="HG-p6">{{Cite book/Hellgate Keep|6}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-environment}}
* A major earthquake devastates the city of [[Eltabbar]] in [[Thay]], following the release of the [[demon lord]] [[Eltab]].<ref name="tGHotR-147" />
* [[Hammer]]: The [[Spotted Plague]] wracks [[Iriaebor]]. The fact that it struck in winter alarms authorities who link it to tattooed men and women seen in the city only scant weeks before the outbreak. They are suspected to have been followers of [[Talona]].<ref name="RtR-p19" />
* [[Mirtul]]: [[Melvaunt]] experiences extremely cold weather in direct contrast to the warm spring in neighboring [[Thentia]]. The machinations of [[Auril]] are suspected even though her worship is taboo in the city.<ref name="RtR-p20" />
* [[Eleasias]]: The fishing nets of [[Luskan]] haul in an oily-black monster resembling a [[dragon]]. After it eats a fisherman it is quickly slain but strange carrion bats begin to devour the corpse before it can be studied. A plague breaks out in the city that is blamed on the creature’s presence.<ref name="RtR-p22" />
* [[Marpenoth]]: A [[featherlung]] plague strikes [[Procampur]]. Hundreds die in the poor district and other districts are blamed for its spread due to their slow reaction. It was spread further when the afflicted traveled to the temples of Helm and [[Torm]] to be cured, so a cleric of [[Lliira]] and a cleric of [[Tymora]] ventured into the poor district to set up a shrine. Those two are reprimanded by the [[Thultyrl]] for their actions, despite the fact that they obviously prevented it spreading further. A mob forms, accusing a sailor from [[Prespur]] (a pirate) of being a priestess of Talona because of her tattoos and they lynch her.<ref name="RtR-p23" />
* [[Uktar]]: [[Chessenta]] experiences an especially bountiful harvest. Chessentan merchants ply the entire [[Sea of Fallen Stars]] and even attempt a dangerous trek to the [[Lake of Steam]] to sell their crops at bargain prices before they spoil. A small army accompanies this latter group across the [[Shaar]] to repel repeated brigand attacks.<ref name="RtR-p23" />
* The autumn frost comes early to the forest of [[Cormanthor]] and the lack of food north of [[Highmoon]] causes the [[leucrotta]] to turn on the [[halflings]] of [[Casckel]] village, eating them all.<ref>{{Cite book/Elminster's Ecologies/Cormanthor|8}}</ref>
* [[Nightal]]: The cold of winter is particularly harsh in most of the Silver Marches.<ref>{{Cite book/Silver Marches|98}}</ref> However, green snow falls for two days over [[Silverymoon]] and [[Everlund]]. It disappears quickly and in its place every fruit-producing plant within two days ride provides a bountiful harvest.<ref>{{Cite book/The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier/Cities & Civilization|50}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-organizations}}
* [[Khelben Arunsun]], leader of the [[Moonstars]], tasks his agent [[Alyn Telarson]] with wandering the Sea of Fallen Stars and reporting back on any strange goings-on.<ref name="SoFS-p4">{{Cite book/Sea of Fallen Stars|4}}</ref>
* [[Ches]]: [[Church of Cyric|Cyricists]] in [[Zhentil Keep]] begin recruiting and kidnapping scribes in the [[Moonsea]] region.<ref name="RtR-p20" />
* [[Flamerule]]: Shond Tharovin espouses the worship of the ''Living Gem'' as a [[god]]. Priests of the [[artefact]] wear rainbow-colored robes and work begins on a temple in front of the vizier’s palace. Other cities in [[Calimshan]] generally view Shond as a madman.<ref name="RtR-p21" />
* [[Marpenoth]]: The [[Iron Throne]] is banished from Cormyr after it is reported that they hired assassins to kill the owners of a rival [[Archendale]]-based company. The Iron Throne attempts to appeal against the decision, claiming the report as baseless libel.<ref name="RtR-p23" />
* [[Nightal]]: The [[Knights of the Flying Hunt]] raid the [[Nelanther Isles]]. No pirate attacks are reported for a while afterward but several smoking, adrift, and deserted ships are reported off the coast of Calimshan. Paranoia grips the [[Lands of Intrigue]] as, although they laud the knights for the destruction of pirates, they wonder what would happen if they attacked the mainland. [[Halruaan skyship]]s are seen heading in the direction of [[Nimbral]].<ref>{{Cite web/Realmslore/The Realm of Nimbral, Part One: Legends, Mysteries, and History}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-people}}
* The [[demon]] lord [[Eltab]] is released from his centuries of imprisonment beneath the city of [[Eltabbar]] in [[Thay]]. [[Szass Tam]], [[Zulkir]] of [[Necromancy]], who released the demon, plots to bind Eltab to his service, but his plans are foiled. Eltab escapes to a [[demoncyst]] under [[Thaymount]].<ref name="tGHotR-147" />
* [[Aeron Morieth]] takes the title of the Stormwalker of the [[Maerchwood]] in [[Chessenta]].<ref name="tGHotR-148" />
* In [[Halruaa]], an old friend of [[Pryce Covington]] is murdered. Suspected of the crime, and mistaken for the famed mage [[Darlington Blade]], Pryce must also investigate the matter.<ref name="tGHotR-148" />
* The victorious dwarves rename the retaken Citadel of Many Arrows as [[Felbarr]], its original dwarven name, and King [[Emerus Warcrown]] takes the throne.<ref name="tGHotR-147" /> They appeal for more dwarves to join them.<ref>{{Cite book/The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier/The Wilderness|11}}</ref>
* [[Hammer]]: [[Myrmeen Lhal]] refuses to allow the building of a temple to [[Helm]] within [[Arabel]]. When the Helmites offer to guard against the [[wild magic]] of the nearby [[Helmlands]] in exchange, she turns them out of the city, citing the fact that if not for their god, the Helmlands wouldn’t exist.<ref name="RtR-p19" />
* [[Ches]]: The [[Neverwinter|Neverwintan]] archmage [[Rahalaglingalade]] creates the ''[[sphere of summer]]''. He is attacked by [[Calishite]] assassins (most notably [[Thyruin]] of the White Flowers who having failed now roams the [[North]]) and kidnappers from several realms. The [[Lords' Alliance]] provides a roster of adventurers to act as bodyguards against further attempts on his life.<ref name="RtR-p20" />
* [[Tarsakh]]: After [[Cormyr]]ian forces from [[High Horn]] begin raiding the [[Tunlands]] in response to increases in bandit activity, Warlord [[Thaalim Torchtower]] vows revenge against [[Azoun IV]] when Thaalim’s youngest son is killed.<ref name="RtR-p20" />
* [[Zaranda Star]] is betrayed by one of her own companions while in [[Ithmong]] and is imprisoned beneath [[Zazesspur]].<ref name="LoI/Tethyr-40">{{Cite book/Lands of Intrigue/Tethyr|40}}</ref>
* [[Mirtul]]: [[Shond Tharovin]] discovers the ''[[Living Gem]]'' in the [[Forest of Mir]]. He parades it around [[Schamedar]].
* Zaranda Star emerges triumphantly from captivity after she and her companions slew [[The One Below]] and its [[fiend]]ish minion. She is declared queen by popular demand and eventually accepts the title after much consultation with local lords.<ref name="LoI/Tethyr-40" />
* King [[Ghellin]] of [[Tethyamar]] contracts a deadly wasting disease at his refuge in the [[Far Hills]]. His condition spurs his peers to hasten their attempt at retaking the king's realm.<ref name="RtR-p21" />
* [[Kythorn]]: The [[deepspawn]] known as [[Clusterfang]] becomes an agent of the [[Twisted Rune]] after the Rune's original deepspawn known as [[The One Below]] is killed by Zaranda Star underneath Zazesspur.<ref>{{Cite book/Lands of Intrigue/Tethyr|40}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book/Lands of Intrigue/Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue|24}}</ref>
* [[Flamerule]]: [[Fzoul Chembryl]] orders the deaths of fifty-three 'unrepentant heretics' in Zhentil Keep.<ref name="RtR-p21" />
* [[Eleint]]: The [[archmage]] [[Yoond Salshymmyr]] curses Shond Tharovin, turning him into a creature much like a [[gibbering mouther]]. Yoond is found transformed into sphere of detached bones that spit fire and lightning shortly afterward. In response to their leader's transformation, the agitated rainbow priests of the ''Living Gem'' begin killing people at random, shouting "The Gem lives!" as confirmation that they will endure.<ref name="RtR-p22" />
* [[Marpenoth]]: Shond Tharovin, now trapped in the form of a monster retreats into Schamedar's sewers after being repeatedly attacked by citizens. Reportedly still able to wield magic, or at least magic items, he evades death while his rainbow priests struggle to keep everyone in line. The Seven Satraps begin to organize concerted attacks on the priesthood while the rainbow priests attempt to reinforce Schamedar’s fortifications.<ref name="RtR-p22" />
* A Red Wizard named [[Rooltasz Tesurpar]] develops an awesome killing spell he calls the ''[[red wind]]'' and uses it to completely annihilate two villages (both of which were ruled by his rivals). Several [[zulkir]]s demand that he turn over the spell and three Red Wizards are killed trying to steal it but Rooltasz seems to go into hiding after a spell battle. Lands surrounding Thay worry that Rooltasz may misuse the spell or, worse, that the spell does wind up in the hands of the zulkirs.<ref name="RtR-p23" />
* In spring, [[the Simbul]] of [[Aglarond]] disappears without explanation, and some think her dead. Many of Aglarond's councilors start to maneuver for control, each attempting to be accepted as a new ruler through acclamation. However, the Simbul returns three months later, and institutes arrangements by which the council would be notified of her death.<ref name="UE-p105">{{Cite book/Unapproachable East|105}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-147" />
* [[Uktar]]: [[Mongo]], Blood of Ghellin gains access to [[Ironfang Keep]] and meets its inhabitants. He is next seen, beaten, at the [[Dragon's Jaws]] tavern in [[Suzail]]. He claims Ironfang is full of [[fiend]]s who chant the names of those who are about to die in an effort to prevent the world from ending. Delirious, he is put to bed but the next morning, his remains are splattered about his room though there is no evidence of violence.<ref name="RtR-p24">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised)/Running the Realms|24}}</ref>
* [[Uktar]]: The [[Night of Pirates]]. [[Nelanther Isles]] pirate-lord [[Elro Starankh]] and crews from three ships descend upon the [[Heartflame]] festhall in the [[Dock Ward of Waterdeep]] and offer its proprietress, [[Nauloene Tharantra]], twenty [[Dragon (coin)|dragons]] a head and 10,000 dragons to each working girl willing to wed one of the pirates. Nearly all accept the offer. During the wild celebration that follows, the Heartflame is torched and severely damaged.<ref name="WN">{{Cite web/Waterdeep News/Tharantra Husband-Hunting Again}}</ref>
* [[Nightal]]: A mage observing the situation in Schamedar reports that Shond Tharovin has escaped into the sea, heading north and west. He claims that Tharovin can now shift between his human and his gibbering mouther form (which he can travel underwater in) and has devised a spell that can track him whenever he is human.<ref name="RtR-p24" />
* [[Brenth Stoutshield]], until recently an officer of [[Arvoreen's Marchers]], discovers a trove of gems while exploring the ruins of [[Xandar]]. He puts his newfound wealth toward building the [[Citadel of the Banner Raised Anew]] across the river from the village of [[Zinner]].<ref>{{Cite book/Demihuman Deities|164}}</ref>
* [[Mithbarakaz|King Mith]] of [[Iltkazar]], due to wake from his Great Sleep as he had done since he took rulership of the Mithral Kingdom, fails to do so.<ref name="Guide-101">{{Cite book/Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark|101}}</ref> Though his subjects do not know this, his astral form has been stolen by [[Tiamat]], in whose clutches he remains imprisoned for a full century.<ref name="FRCG-234">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide|234}}</ref>
* [[Jarlaxle]] and [[Artemis Entreri]] arrive in the [[Bloodstone Lands]].<ref>{{Cite book/Realms of Shadow/That Curious Sword}}</ref>
* On the shores of [[Lake Myrloch]], the Great Druid of the [[Moonshae Isles]], [[Robyn Kendrick]], is given a cryptic warning that "[[Sarifal]] is awakening" by a [[Sprite (creature)|sprite]] ally.<ref>{{Cite dragon/362/Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes|29}}</ref>
* In [[Skullport]], some rumors claimed that [[Griggen Ekmiran]] paid a gang to demolish his customers' taverns until one of the rumormongers was found dead and the rumors stopped.<ref name="SP-p58">{{Cite book/Skullport|58}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* All [[Waterdeep]] is shocked when Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun reveals himself as a [[Lords of Waterdeep|Masked Lord of Waterdeep]], then resigns from his position.<ref name="tGHotR-147" />
* [[Shoundra Stargleam]] becomes [[Sceptrana]] of [[Mirabar]] and governs the city in concert with [[Marchion]] [[Elastul Raurym]] and the [[Council of Sparkling Stones]].<ref name="tGHotR-148">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|148}}</ref>
* In the Hordelands, the [[Tuigan]] establish [[Kourmira]], capital of [[Yaïmmunahar]].<ref name="tGHotR-148" />
* [[Kythorn]]: Shond Tharovin uses the ''Living Gem'' to make himself vizier of Schamedar. He displays his might to his citizens by displaying his magical murder of the former vizier via a [[scry]]ing mirror and demands their obedience.<ref name="RtR-p21" />
* [[Eleasias]]: High Queen [[Alicia Kendrick]] appeals to the [[Lords of Waterdeep]] to allow her to establish a [[Moonshae]] embassy in the city. The move is hailed as a splendid one and an official royal visit is planned for Ches of [[1368 DR]].<ref name="RtR-p21" />

{{Yearbox/misc}}
* The [[First Andonian Games]] are held in the city of [[Ravens Bluff]].<ref name="THfDM-p11">{{Cite organized play/LC/The Hunt for Discount Merlin|11}}</ref>{{Andonian-Time}}
* A road is completed between [[Mulsantir]] and [[Tinner]] in [[Thesk]].<ref name="tGHotR-147" />
* Many sages, philosophers, priests and [[cleric]]s throughout [[Faerûn]] predict that over the next decade, beasts will reclaim the lands where men currently rule.<ref>{{Cite book/The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier/The Wilderness|12}}</ref>
* Daring pirates of the [[Inner Sea]] venture beneath the waves to the [[Hmur Plateau]] in search of treasure. They rob a [[dragon turtle]] of its riches, and many pay for it with their lives, though the survivors carry away magical treasures.<ref name="tGHotR-147" />
* [[Alturiak]]: A group of drow, at least forty strong, attack a caravan west of [[Priapurl]]. Several adventuring bands begin a search for the group and demand for caravan guards increases threefold.<ref name="RtR-p19" />
* [[Mirtul]]: Drow are spotted on the streets of [[Calaunt]]. Coupled with the slaughter of a local adventuring band, the [[Ladies of the Green Shield]], and strange activity at the city docks at night, assumptions are made about a secret alliance with the dark elves.<ref name="RtR-p20" />
* Kythorn: A two-headed flying [[wyvern]]-like creature is claimed to have attacked a hunting expedition from [[Arrabar]] in the [[Chondalwood]]. No such creature has ever been recorded as being seen before.<ref name="RtR-p21" />
* [[Flamerule]]: A beverage called [[Ice Wine]] appears in the markets of [[Selgaunt]]. Its discoverer, [[Ghalivar Braceltar]] claims that it is [[remorhaz]] milk. Sages scoff at such a claim but the drink becomes incredibly popular in [[Sembia]], selling for one [[gold piece]] per bottle. Interest begins to grow in other Sea of Fallen Stars ports.<ref name="RtR-p21" />
* [[Eleint]]: A magical vortex sucks up [[Castle Spulzeer]] in Tethyr, leaving only a hole in the ground.<ref name="CS-57">{{Cite book/Castle Spulzeer|57}}</ref>
* Many are found dead in [[Westgate]], locked in vaults or crammed into chests and other containers. A sage suspects [[lock lurker]]s have been introduced into the city’s coinage while others suspect a drow plot or wizard's curse. Paranoia is rampant.<ref name="RtR-p22" />
* An adventurer kills a giant wolf spider of singularly remarkable size that glows yellow even after death in the woods south of [[Shadowdale]]. He trades it to [[Jhaele Silvermane]] of the [[Old Skull Inn]] who hangs it as a trophy. It is nicknamed "Otto".<ref name="RtR-p22" />
* [[Uktar]]: After repeated pranks involving "Otto" the wolf spider being thrown into various people’s bedrooms (and on top of [[Elminster]]!) Lord [[Mourngrym Amcathra|Mourngrym]] seizes the corpse to display in the [[Twisted Tower]], where hopefully the young and the stupid won't be tempted to take it.<ref name="RtR-p23" />
* [[Nightal]]: A creature with the head of a serpent and the body of a giant raven comes out of the Helmlands just after the [[Feast of the Moon]] to swoop over Arabel. It destroys a warehouse before crashing into the city streets, apparently taken down by a magical attack. No one claims the kill as theirs.<ref name="RtR-p24" />
* After a [[unicorn]] is spotted by the road south of [[Waterdeep]], arguments ensue between a priest of [[Mielikki]] and a priest of [[Lurue]] over which god is responsible for its appearance. A party of adventurers devoted to Lurue slay three bands of raiding orcs and a priest of [[Malar]] in celebration before a [[druid]] in [[Daggerford]] claims the unicorn is his friend who fell afoul of a warding spell and appeals to mages to dispel the effects. Some faithful continue to decry the druid as "old and crazy", leading to continued debate.<ref name="RtR-p24" />
* Construction ends on the [[Spirit Soaring]], a temple dedicated to [[Oghma]] and [[Deneir]] in the [[Snowflake Mountains]].<ref name="TCC">{{Cite book/The Chaos Curse}}</ref>
* This year is known as the Year of Unmasking in the [[Black Chronology]].<ref name="C.TotW-159">{{Cite book/Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave|159}}</ref><ref name="TGHotR-157">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|157}}</ref>
* The [[Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised)]] boxed set covers up to the end of this year.<ref name="D196-66">{{Cite dragon/196/Novel Ideas|66}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-conflicts}}
* Winter: The [[Many-Arrows]] [[orc]]s displace a group of [[Hill giant|hill]], [[Fog giant|fog]] and [[cloud giant]]s in the [[Spine of the World]], that form a warband and drive the [[troll]]s from the local moorlands. These trolls go on to make frequent wild attacks on the town of [[Nesmé]].<ref name="SM-p6">{{Cite book/Silver Marches|6}}</ref>
* [[Hammer (month)|Hammer]]: In the [[Second Banedeath]], the [[church of Cyric]] searches for non-[[Cyric]]-worshiping priests in [[Zhentil Keep]] and the [[Zhent]] holdings of [[Yûlash]], [[Darkhold]], [[Teshwave]], and the [[Citadel of the Raven]]. Only in Darkhold do they find any success as the non-Cyricists in the other settlements have already gone underground.<ref name="C&D-p9">{{Cite book/Cloak & Dagger|9}}</ref><ref name="GHR-148">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|148}}</ref>
* [[Uktar]]: The [[War of the Shining Crusade|war]] between [[Shining Crusade]] and the [[Coalition]] begins.<ref name="BG.SoD">{{Cite game/Baldur's Gate: Siege of Dragonspear}}</ref><ref name="Realms year" group="note">The first date in the in-game journal is [[Uktar 12]], 1368 DR.</ref>
* [[Nightal]]: [[Zhentil Keep]] is besieged by an army of [[frost giant]]s, [[gnoll]]s, and other [[humanoid]]s.<ref name="RoZK.CB-p25">{{Cite book/Ruins of Zhentil Keep/Campaign Book|25}}</ref>
* [[Nightal 28]], [[Nightal 29|29]], and [[Nightal 30|30]]: [[Fzoul Chembryl]] reads the ''[[True Life of Cyric]]'' aloud to the people of [[Zhentil Keep]], revealing the god's betrayal. The High Priest of Cyric, [[Xeno Mirrormane]], is slain by divine fires sent by the god [[Mask]], which then burn Cyric's temple. Cyric summons an army of giants, [[dragon]]s, and other monsters that sack the city, and Fzoul escapes to Teshwave.<ref name="GHR-149"/>
* The [[Blue Bear tribe]], led by shaman and chieftain [[Tanta Hagara]], marches on the [[fiend]]-ridden fortress of [[Hellgate Keep]]. Surprising everyone, both she and her followers survive and claim rulership of the site.<ref name="SM-p98">{{Cite book/Silver Marches|98}}</ref>
* A force of [[Ghaunadaur|Ghaunadans]] and [[slime]]s attack the [[Promenade of the Dark Maiden]] in retaliation for the destruction of the [[Pit of Ghaunadaur]] 600 years ago.<ref name="LaPeTri">{{Cite book/Ascendancy of the Last|?}}</ref>
* [[Espar]], [[Eveningstar]], [[Tyrluk]] and [[Waymoot]] are plagued by rogue dragons.<ref name="FRCS2eR.GTotR-p53">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised)/A Grand Tour of the Realms|53}}</ref>
* The [[longship]]s of King [[Selger]] from [[Trisk]] attack and defeat the neighboring island-kingdom of [[Utheraal]].<ref name="NSF-41">{{Cite book/The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier/The Wilderness|41}}</ref>
* The [[iron crisis]] begins as [[Sarevok]] and the [[Iron Throne]] use [[kobolds]] led by [[Mulahey]] to "poison" the [[iron]] mines of [[Nashkel]] in order to ultimately foment conflict between [[Amn]] and [[Baldur's Gate]].<ref name="BG">{{Template:Cite game/Baldur's Gate}}</ref><ref name="GHR-148" /><ref group="note" name="BGII Timeline">While the ''[[Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn (novel)|Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn]]'' and ''[[Baldur's Gate II: Throne of Bhaal (novel)|Throne of Bhaal]]'' novels, along with ''[[The Grand History of the Realms]]'', state that this event happens in 1368 DR, the timelines of the ''[[Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn]]'' and ''[[Baldur's Gate II: Throne of Bhaal|Throne of Bhaal]]'' games are used for the purposes of this wiki.</ref>
* [[Garagos]] manifests in the [[Fields of Nun]] to destroy a [[marilith]] imposter who had started a cult in his name.<ref name="PP-p18">{{Cite book/Powers & Pantheons|18}}</ref>
* Luskan goes to war with [[Lantan]]. The fighting is both devastating and swift, forcing Luskan's fleet to retreat after a very short time. Attempts to conquer [[Mintarn]] and [[Orlumbor]] over the next five years are also costly failures.<ref name="VoloN-p112" >{{Cite book/Volo's Guide to the North|112}}</ref>
* To cause havoc in [[Rashemen]], [[Thay]]an forces set fire to the western [[Ashenwood]] and magical creatures flee east into settled lands. Meanwhile, bands of assassins teleport into [[Immilmar]] and [[Mulsantir]] to murder prominent Rashemi, but they are defeated by Rashemi berserkers.<ref name="GHR-149"/>
* Zhentarim outposts are again subjected to Cyricist inquisitions to root out [[Iyachtu Xvim|Xvimlar]] faithful.<ref name="D196-66">{{Cite dragon/196/Novel Ideas|66}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/deaths}}
* [[Hammer 4]]: [[Kurth Dracomore]] and his followers in Darkhold are killed by Cyricist inquisitors as a message to [[Fzoul Chembryl]].<ref name="C&D-p9">{{Cite book/Cloak & Dagger|9}}</ref>
* [[Mirtul 3]]: The sage [[Gorion]] of [[Candlekeep]] is slain by [[Sarevok]] outside of [[Candlekeep]] during the night as he attempts to flee with [[Abdel Adrian]].<ref name="BG" /><ref group="note" name="BGII Timeline" /><ref group="note" name="BGI Start Timeline">The starting calendar date for BG1 is 2nd Mirtul 1368.</ref>
* [[Nightal 27]]: Fzoul murders [[Xeno Mirrormane]] after Fzoul reads aloud from ''[[The True Life of Cyric]]'' and discovers Cyric's treachery.<ref name="RoZK.CB-p25">{{Cite book/Ruins of Zhentil Keep/Campaign Book|25}}</ref>
* Adventurers sponsored by the [[Zhent]]s break into the [[Great Worm Cavern]] and slay [[Elrem|Elrem the Wise]], shaman leader of the [[Great Worm tribe]] of the [[Uthgardt]].<ref name="SM-p98">{{Cite book/Silver Marches|98}}</ref>
* [[Luer Dhostar]], Croamark of [[Westgate]], is murdered by his son.<ref name="Masq">{{Cite book/Masquerades}}</ref>
* King [[Bromm (Purple Rocks)|Bromm]] from [[Utheraal]] dies defending the capital city of [[Vilkstead]], along with 200 of the island's finest warriors, from an attack by the neighboring kingdom of [[Trisk]].<ref name="NSF-41">{{Cite book/The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier/The Wilderness|41}}</ref>
*[[Sarevok Anchev|Sarevok]] is slain by the party of [[Abdel Adrian]] in the [[Undercity]] beneath [[Baldur's Gate]] ending his quest for godhood.<ref name="BG" /><ref group="note" name="BGII Timeline" />
*Grand Duke [[Entar Silvershield]] of Baldur’s Gate is assassinated as part of [[Sarevok Anchev|Sarevok]]'s attempted takeover, though subsequently resurrected.<ref name="BG" /><ref name="GHR-148" /><ref group="note" name="BGII Timeline" />

{{Yearbox/in-organizations}}
* The [[Fellowship of the Purple Staff]] is founded in the [[Dragon Coast]] region.<ref name="CoV-p80">{{Cite book/Champions of Valor|80}}</ref>
* [[Mirtul]]: [[Victor Dhostar]] is defeated and unmasked as the [[Faceless]] of the [[Night Masks]] by [[Alias]], [[Dragonbait]], and a few [[Harpers]]. Hundreds of Night Mask members are killed or imprisoned as a result.<ref name="Masq"/><ref name="GHR-149"/>
* A temple dedicated to [[Oghma]], named the [[Font of Knowledge]], is established in [[Waterdeep]].<ref name="GHR-149"/>
* The [[Unseen]] attempt to infiltrate the [[Arcane Brotherhood]] by placing agents within the latest batch of [[Host Tower of the Arcane|Host Tower]] recruits. The plan fails and the Brotherhood hires Luskan-based adventurers, [[Mask's Conscripts]], to assault an Unseen base in [[Undermountain]] but they lose their lives in the ensuing battle, giving the Unseen a good cover in [[Luskan]] when they visit the city.<ref>{{Cite book/Cloak & Dagger|99}}</ref>
* Without [[Shond Tharovin]], the [[Seven Satraps]] finally manage to successfully assault [[Schamedar]], driving the [[Cult of the Living Gem]] out of the city. The Seven Satraps conquer Schamedar but internal politics inhibit their leadership.<ref>{{Cite book/Empires of the Shining Sea|38-39,45}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/migrations}}
* Forced out of their homes by other [[giant]]s, large numbers of [[troll]]s come to inhabit regions of the [[Evermoors]], threatening both [[Nesmé]] and the surrounding trade routes.<ref name="SM-p98">{{Cite book/Silver Marches|98}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-deities}}
* Sponsored by the deity [[Talos]], the [[lich]] [[Velsharoon]] becomes a god himself.<ref name="GHR-149">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|149}}</ref>
* Having been thought destroyed by [[Tempus]], [[Garagos]] makes a reappearance to crush the [[marilith]] [[Glackzana]], who had been forming a cult in the Blood Reaver's name in the village of [[Gosra]].<ref name="PaP-18">{{Cite book/Powers & Pantheons|18}}</ref>
* [[Iyachtu Xvim]], the godly son of [[Bane]], tries to trick [[Lathander]] into merging [[Beshaba]] and [[Tymora]] to restore [[Tyche]]. His plans are foiled by [[Joel]], the Rebel Bard; [[Emilio Haversack]], a [[kender]] ''[[gate]]d'' to [[Sigil]]; and their companions.<ref name="GHR-148"/>
* A priestess of Bane named [[Walinda]] tries to restore her deceased deity by retrieving a lost [[artifact]], the ''[[Hand of Bane]]''. Joel also disrupts her plans, and the ''Hand'' is destroyed.<ref name="GHR-149"/>

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* [[Danilo Thann]] resigns as [[Lord of Waterdeep]] and is replaced by [[Kyriani Agrivar]].<ref name="Splendors-87">{{Cite book/City of Splendors: Waterdeep|87}}</ref>
* [[Zaranda Star]] becomes queen of [[Tethyr]].<ref name="LoI3.E&FoI-p29">{{Cite book/Lands of Intrigue/Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue|29}}</ref>
* Following a year and a half of negotiations, [[Helmsport]] and [[New Waterdeep]] in [[Maztica]] are opened to all traders, leading to the opening of major trade routes between Maztica and [[Faerûn]]. Helmsport and New Waterdeep establish competitor shipbuilding industries that improve trade, while [[Qorol]] thrives on agriculture feeding [[Amn]].<ref name="GHR-149"/>
* Despite the trade agreements, Waterdhavian ships and Amn is suspected of sabotage. The [[Lords' Alliance]] discreetly collects evidence and plans to censure Amn for illegal interference with lawful trade and violating the deals.<ref name="GHR-149"/>
* Cloakmaster [[Teldin Moore]] comes to the world of [[Toril]] and meets with Queen [[Amlaruil]] of [[Evermeet]].<ref name="GHR-149"/>
* [[Rassendyll Uoumdolphin]] murders his twin brother [[Selfaril Uoumdolphin]], High Blade of [[Mulmaster]].{{Template:Sefaril-Rassendyll-time}} Assuming his brother's identity, he marries the unwitting [[Dmitra Flass]], a Tharchioness of Eltabbar and a [[Red Wizard   of Thay]]. She spends much of her time in Eltabbar, however, and does not notice the switch. With the marriage, [[Thay]] maintains a strong presence in Mulmaster.<ref name="GHR-149"/>{{Dmitra-Selfaril-marriage}}
* Thay establishes [[Thayan enclave|enclaves]] in [[Cimbar]], [[Phsant]], [[Proskur]], and [[Tsurlagol]], while Thay's [[zulkir]]s increased production and export of magical items. The enclave in Phsant becomes popular with merchants on the [[Golden Way]].<ref name="GHR-149"/>
* Waterdeep experiences a craze for ''[[dream sphere]]s'', which appeal to a desire for a better life. Experimenting in the creation of ''dream spheres'', [[Oth Eltorchul]], son of Lord [[Thesp Eltorchul]], is reduced to a babbling vegetative state. Meanwhile, nobles feud behind the scenes. [[Arilyn Moonblade]] and [[Danilo Thann]] discover the cause of the issues.<ref name="GHR-149"/>
* Prince [[Haedrak III]] emerges from hiding and visits Waterdeep, where he rallies many Waterdhavian youths to join his [[Reclamation Army]] on a mission to restore the monarchy of [[Tethyr]]. They sail for the troubled land, intending to join forces with [[Zaranda Star]]'s loyalists.<ref name="GHR-149"/>
*[[Sarevok Anchev|Serevok]], aided by the [[Iron Throne]] makes a concerted attempt to become the sole remaining duke of [[Baldur's Gate]] but his plans to assassinate the dukes [[Belt (human)|Belt]] and [[Liia Jannath]] are exposed by the party of [[Abdel Adrian]] and he is forced to flee to the [[Undercity]].<ref name="BG" /><ref group="note" name="BGII Timeline" />

{{Yearbox/in-environment}}
* The [[Forest of Lethyr]] is struck by a plague that attacks the minds of [[treant]]s, turning them into nothing more than ordinary trees.<ref name="GHR-149"/>

{{Yearbox/in-Realmspace}}
* A fleet of [[scro]] [[spelljammer]]s left over from the [[Second Unhuman War]] enters [[Realmspace]] and trades weapons and [[smokepowder]] with inhabitants of [[Faerûn]] while in orbit around [[Toril]].<ref name="RoM">{{Cite book/Realms of Magic/Gunne Runner}}</ref><ref name="DA96-p46">{{Cite dragon annual/1996/Campaign Classics: The Scro|46}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/misc}}
* Around the spring season, the [[Second Andonian Games]] are held in [[Ravens Bluff]].<ref name="THfDM-p8-9">{{Cite organized play/LC/The Hunt for Discount Merlin|8-9}}</ref>{{Andonian-Time}}
* The [[Lost Library of Cormanthyr]] is found by [[Baylee Arnvold]].<ref name="GHR-148"/>
* The [[Great Aviary of Extaminos]] is completed in [[Hlondeth]].<ref>{{Cite web/More of the Vilhon Reach}}</ref>
* The [[Tree Ghost tribe]] of the [[Uthgardt]] rediscovers the [[Grandfather Tree]], its long-lost ancestor mound in the [[High Forest]].<ref name="GHR-149"/>
* A temple to [[Oghma]] called the [[Font of Knowledge]] is founded in Waterdeep.<ref name="GHR-149"/>
* This year is known as the Year of the Sons in the [[Black Chronology]].<ref name="C.TotW-159">{{Cite book/Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave|159}}</ref><ref name="TGHotR-157">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|157}}</ref>
* A citadel, similar in many respects to that of [[Castle Perilous]], seems to build itself just outside the town of [[Palischuk]] in [[Vaasa]].<ref>{{Cite book/Promise of the Witch-King/Hardcover (2005)}}</ref>
* [[Iron golem]]s crash the annual [[Regatta Ball]].<ref name="Masq"/>
* [[Druid]]s all across the [[Myrloch Vale]] are called to enter the [[moonwell]]s. The Great Druid [[Robyn Kendrick]] resists the call, with the help of her [[faerie dragon]] friend [[Newt (faerie dragon)|Newt]].<ref>{{Cite dragon/362/Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes|29}}</ref>
* An especially good quality [[grape]] harvest results in bottling of [[Brother Tobias' 1368]] [[wine]] in the city of [[Westgate]]. The wine would remain a local staple at least through the {{YearlinkName|1374}}.<ref name="nwn2W">{{Cite game/Neverwinter Nights 2: Mysteries of Westgate}}</ref>
* Construction of [[Lord Trillnauch's Villa]] in [[Skullport]] is completed.<ref name="SP-p59">{{Cite book/Skullport|59}}</ref>

*[[Mirtul 2]]: A guild of [[vampire]]s led by [[Bodhi]] clash with the [[Shadow Thieves]] for control of the underworld of [[Athkatla]]. The [[Shadow Thieves]] in retaliation attack the dungeon of her brother [[Jon Irenicus]] which facilitates the escape of [[Abdel Adrian]], [[Imoen]], [[Jaheira]] and [[Minsc]] from captivity at his hands. <ref name="BG2-ToB" /><ref name="BGII Timeline" group="note" />
* [[Kythorn 4]]: Iakhovas attacks [[Baldur's Gate]], again, causing trade with Maztica to cease.<ref name="C&D-10">{{Cite book/Cloak & Dagger|10}}</ref>
*[[Flamerule 24]]: Start of the [[Twelfth Serôs War]]. Using an artifact found in [[Coryselmal]], Iakhovas shatters a portion of the [[Sharksbane Wall]], destroying in the process the [[sea elf]] city of [[Akhanmyr]] and an [[Order of the Sea Unicorns]] guardpost. Iakhovas leads a host of [[sahuagin]] through the breach before occupying Coryselmal.<ref name="tGHotR-149" /><ref name="SoFS-p73">{{Cite book/Sea of Fallen Stars|73}}</ref>
* In [[Maztica]], raiders of [[Kultaka]] burn [[New Waterdeep]] to the ground. Refugees escape to [[Trythosford]], but Waterdeep cannot send help because of the Deepwater War.<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* The armies besieging [[Zhentil Keep]] remained entrenched, but Lord [[Orgauth]] rallies the surviving soldiers of the Keep and seizes control, with none to oppose him.<ref name="tGHotR-149" /> Finally, in [[Mirtul]], the last of the forces besieging Zhentil Keep abandon their attacks.<ref name="C&D-p9" />
* Overall, attacks by sea creatures limit trade between Maztica and [[Faerûn]].<ref name="tGHotR-149" />
* The [[Harpers]] [[Spellviper]] and [[Cryshana]] volunteer for a suicide mission to take a piece of the ''[[Gatekeeper's Crystal]]'' into [[Hellgate Keep]]. The [[Mistmaster]] then uses it to destroy the majority of the keep while [[Turlang]] and his [[treant]]s block the pass to the ruins.<ref name="FH">{{Cite book/Forsaken House}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-149"/><ref name="C&D-93" />
* [[Gold dwarf]] crusaders from the [[Great Rift]] and [[gray dwarves]] from [[Dunspeirrin]] both march to retake [[Deep Shanatar]]. When they meet, they clash in the [[War of Gold and Gloom]],<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* In the winter, [[Thay]] invades [[Aglarond]] once again, with [[Szass Tam]] raising a huge army of [[undead]] that march over the frozen [[Umber Marshes]]. The undead hurl themselves against the [[Watchwall]] fortification, but cannot overcome it.<ref name="UE-p105">{{Cite book/Unapproachable East|105}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* [[the Five|Five]] powerful [[Bhaalspawn]]s wage a [[Bhaalspawn crisis|great war]] in Tethyr, killing nearly all the others of their kind. ** Xvim possesses [[Fzoul Chembryl]] and sets him on the path to become the Tyrant of the [[Moonsea]].<ref name="C&D-p10">{{Cite book/Cloak and Dagger|10}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
** [[Marpenoth 10]]: Fzoul takes over as head of the church of Xvim in Zhentil Keep.<ref name="C&D-p10"/><ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* [[Mielikki]] creates a new home for herself in the [[Outer Planes]],<ref name="FAA-57">{{Cite book/Faiths & Avatars|57}}</ref> the [[Grove of the Unicorns]] in the [[Beastlands (plane)|Beastlands]].<ref name="FAA-112">{{Cite book/Faiths & Avatars|112}}</ref>
* Seemingly despite her lack of divine power, [[Eldath]] moves the [[True Grove]] to [[Eronia]], a layer of [[Elysium]].<ref name="FAA-57" />
* The remaining power of Bhaal is gathered and hidden away.<ref name="BG2-SoA"/><ref group="note" name="BGII Timeline" />

{{Yearbox/in-environment}}
* [[Flamerule 1]]: The [[Ship of the Gods]] island volcano erupts. [[Alaor]] and [[Bezantur]] are engulfed by tsunamis and devastated. Mulhorand grabs the opportunity to seize Alaor, but only briefly.<ref name="SoFS-p13">{{Cite book/Sea of Fallen Stars|13}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
*Multiple ''pools of radiance'' resurfaced in the cities of the Moonsea region, including [[Phlan]]. The ''pools'' started draining life-forces of the citizens of the cities. [[Elminster Aumar]] assembled two adventuring groups to investigate the activities of the Cult of the Dragon in Myth Drannor that were connected to the calamity.<ref name="POD2" />

{{Yearbox/migrations}}
* Violent [[Fog giant|fog]] and [[cloud giant]]s from the [[Evermoors]] attack [[Nesmé]]. The [[troll]] attacks of [[1368 DR|last year]] also increase in number and ferocity, causing the downfall of several small settlements between [[Everlund]] and [[Yartar]]. It is discovered that this is due to more friendly fog and cloud giants (as well as a [[black dragon]]) who have displaced the trolls.<ref name="MoMT-p17">{{Cite dungeon/144/The Muster of Morach Tor|17}}</ref>
* Inspired by growing with the east, along the [[Golden Way]] and elsewhere, merchants from various lands build trading outposts in [[Almorel]], [[Kourmira]] and [[Rashemen]]. A band of [[shield dwarf]] settlers impress the [[Rashemi]] with their prowess with the axe, forge, and tankard.<ref name="P7M"/>

{{Yearbox/in-organizations}}
* [[Eleasias]] The [[Iron Throne]] issues a public warning that too many weapons bought without their consent in the region surrounding Baldur's Gate will be met with reprisals.<ref name="C&D-10" />
* [[Eleint]]: Young Harpers supporting the [[Janessar]] are kidnapped in [[Myratma]] by the [[Rundeen]].<ref name="C&D-10" />
* The [[Blue Bear tribe]] and their [[tanar'ri]] allies make a concerted effort to take the [[Citadel of the Mists]]. Tanta Hagara and her army are destroyed.<ref name="SM-p27">{{Cite book/Silver Marches|27}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* The [[Twisted Rune]] places a magical gate on the [[Nelanther Isles]] to allow for instantaneous movement to other locations.<ref name="LoI.E-p24">{{Cite book/Lands of Intrigue/Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue|24}}</ref>
* [[Shyressa]] of the Twisted Rune tries to take control of [[Zerith Hold]] in [[Erlkazar]], but is defeated by Lord [[Purdun]], [[Liam (rebel)|Liam]], and [[Ryder]].<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* After six centuries, the [[Dukar Orders]] reveal themselves to the races of [[Serôs]] at [[Myth Nantar]]. Many [[aquatic elves]], [[morkoth]]s, [[shalarin]]s, and even beings from the surface world join the Dukars to serve as peacekeepers for Myth Nantar and the [[Nantarn Alliance]].<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* The [[Fire Knives]] assassin guild is refounded in [[Westgate]] following the Abraxus Affair in Cormyr.<ref name="tGHotR-149"/><ref name="C&D-p63">{{Cite book/Cloak & Dagger|63}}</ref>
*The [[Cult of the Dragon]] led by [[Kya Mordrayn]] took over the ruins of Myth Drannor corrupting its ''mythal'' and a ''[[pool of radiance]]''. Their attempt to conquer the Moonsea region via the ''weave's'' ''pools'' was thwarted by two separate groups of adventurers.<ref name="POD2" />

{{Yearbox/in-people}}
* Late in the year, [[Ravens Bluff]]'s deputy mayor [[Howard Holiday]] leaves to the east on a secret investigation and doesn't return.<ref name="poly147-p23" />
** In Howard Holiday's absence, [[Belanor Fenmarel]] is named the new deputy mayor of Ravens Bluff.<ref name="poly147-p23">{{Cite polyhedron/147/Pillars of Ravens Bluff|23}}</ref>
* [[Halaster's Higharvestide]] occurs:<ref name="USp6-8">{{Cite book/Undermountain: Stardock|6-8}}</ref>
** [[Halaster Blackcloak]] is kidnapped from [[Undermountain]] by members of the [[Twisted Rune]].<ref name="tGHotR-149"/> He later escapes with the help of adventures hired by the [[Lords of Waterdeep]].<ref name="UMSD">{{Cite book/Undermountain: Stardock|?}}</ref>
** No longer protected by Halaster, [[Shradin Mulophor]] is destroyed by the [[Skulls of Skullport]], who reign supreme in [[Skullport]].<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
** [[Arcturia]] is killed by [[frost giant]]s, but is reborn as a horrific [[aberration]].<ref name="CoSWp129">{{Cite book/City of Splendors: Waterdeep|129}}</ref>
** [[Trobriand|Trobriand "the Metal Mage"]] is driven from his lair in Undermountain.<ref name="UMSD-p7">{{Cite book/Undermountain: Stardock|7}}</ref>
** [[Piergeiron the Paladinson]] slays the [[dracolich]] [[Kistarianth the Red]] on the slopes of [[Mount Waterdeep]]. Before becoming undead, Kistarianth had been killed by Piergeiron's father, [[Athar the Shining Knight]].<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
** The [[lich]] [[Sothus Zeth]] uses a ''[[gate]]'' to escape from Undermountain to [[Myth Drannor]] with a herd of fifteen [[nightmare]]s.<ref name="UMSD-p8">{{Cite book/Undermountain: Stardock|8}}</ref>
** The vaults under [[Darkhold]] fill with monsters from [[Undermountain]], keeping [[Sememmon]] and his forces busy.<ref name="C&D-10" />
** The [[blue dragon]] [[Araugauthos]] escapes Undermountain and kills a [[red dragon]] near [[Citadel Amnur]], stealing his hoard of treasure. She then flies southward to find her mother, [[Iryklathagra]].<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* Halaster, tainted by [[Shar]], plots to steal the secret of ''[[silver fire]]'' from [[Mystra]] and her [[Chosen of Mystra|Chosen]], but is foiled by the [[Seven Sisters]].<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* [[Kythorn]]: An [[illithid]] trader named [[Fith]] arrives in Skullport with three [[beholder]] slaves with their central eyes burned out. This makes him a target of the [[Xanathar]] but his agents are killed and Fith leaves the city.<ref name="C&D-10" />
* Following the destruction of Hellgate Keep, Countess [[Sarya Dlardrageth]] and her companions are accidentally freed from their prison. They then go about releasing the [[fey'ri]].<ref name="C&D-93">{{Cite book/Cloak & Dagger|93}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* The book ''[[Gloryswords: An Informal And Incomplete Overview of Adventuring Bands in the Year of the Spur]]'', by [[Ragefast]], Sage of Baldur's Gate, is published.<ref>{{Cite book/Swords of Eveningstar/Hardcover 2006|1}}</ref>
* [[Vheod Runechild]], a half-[[demon]] [[cambion]], escapes the [[Abyss]] and comes to [[Toril]], where he struggles to drive the [[balor]] [[Chare'en]] from the [[Dalelands]].<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
*The [[Cult of the Dragon]]'s [[Kya Mordrayn]] failed to execute her plan to conquer the Moonsea region and upon her defeat, as a punishment for her failure she was dragged into the [[Abyss]] by the devils she made a pact with.<ref name="POD2" />
*[[Alhoon]] [[Hwarlg]] was released from being bound by a ''[[dimensional anchor]]'' inside the [[Crypt of Rothilion]] in Myth Drannor.<ref name="POR-p43">{{Cite book/Pool of Radiance: Attack on Myth Drannor|43}}</ref>
*[[Rivener]], an extremely powerful [[demon]] was released from its prison under [[Castle Cormanthor]] after 700 years of imprisonment. He was defeated and banished from the Prime Material Plane.<ref name="POD2" />
*Sorcerer [[Jarial]] was released from his curse that kept him alive and unaging for many years. He aided the heroes from [[Phlan]] in stopping the activities of the Cult of the Dragon in Myth Drannor.<ref name="POD2" />
* Against the wishes of [[Alicia Kendrick|Queen Alicia]], [[Robyn Kendrick|Robyn]] and [[Tristan Kendrick]] enter [[Feywild|Faerie]] to search for all of the druids who disappeared the previous year.<ref name="Dr362-GHotR">{{Cite dragon/362/Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes|30}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* [[Alturiak]]: Two groups of monsters invade the [[Nameless Dungeon]] and drive off the elven defenders.<ref name="SM-p28-29">{{Cite book/Silver Marches|28-29}}</ref>
* [[Marpenoth 24]]: Fzoul and Khelben Arunsun meet in [[Voonlar]]. In exchange for information on [[Orgauth]], Fzoul agrees to not expand his influence beyond the eastern [[Thunder Peaks]] for 10,000 days.<ref name="C&D-p10"/><ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* [[Marpenoth 29]]: Orgauth is granted rulership of Zhentil Keep after forming an alliance with Fzoul.<ref name="C&D-p10"/>
* [[Nightal 8]]: [[Mintar]] allies itself with Fzoul.<ref name="C&D-p12>{{Cite book/Cloak and Dagger|12}}</ref>
* Fzoul also makes an alliance with the High Blade of [[Mulmaster]], in order to discover the location of two Imperceptors of Bane in that city.<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* Lady [[Alustriel Silverhand]] steps down as High Mage of [[Silverymoon]]. [[Taern Hornblade]], one of her senior advisors and leader of her [[Spellguard]], succeeds her.<ref name="FRCS-p173">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|173}}</ref>
* The [[Zhentarim]] take over the village of [[Orlbar]] in the [[Delimbiyr Vale]].<ref name="TN-C&C-p62">{{Cite book/The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier/Cities & Civilization|62}}</ref>
* [[Randal Morn]] and his riders take back [[Dagger Falls]] from the [[Zhentarim]].<ref name="FRCS-p127">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|127}}</ref> Morn reclaims the rulership of [[Daggerdale]].<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* The [[Abraxus affair]] occurs, in which an attempt is made on King [[Azoun IV]]'s life by a magical bull-like creature.<ref name="CaN-p20-27">{{Cite book/Cormyr: A Novel/Paperback 1998|20-27}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-149"/> He escapes, and members of the [[Bleth]] and [[Cormaeril]] noble families are exiled for their part in it.<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* The [[Reclamation Wars]] come to an end and the [[Rhindaun Dynasty]] begins in [[Tethyr]] with the marriage and coronation of [[Zaranda Star]] and [[Haedrak Rhindaun III]].<ref name=LoI1:T-pp45-46">{{Cite book/Lands of Intrigue/Tethyr|45-46}}</ref><ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* Dwarves of Mirabar establish the [[House of the Axe]] and ally with the crystal dragon Saryndalaghlothtor.<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* Following the end of the [[Twelfth Serôs War]], the allied races gather at [[Myth Nantar]] for the [[Nantarn Feasts]] to celebrate.<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* [[Ghellin]], king-in-exile of the [[Iron House]] of [[Tethyamar]], passes away. He is succeeded by his twin sons [[Tasster]] and [[Teszter]].<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>

{{Yearbox/misc}}
* A court case over the working rights of undead, particularly vampires, takes place in the city of Ravens Bluff. Presided over by Magistrate [[Justin Valerius]], the company [[DMI Incorporated|DMHOC]], framing themselves as an equal opportunity employer, argues that the laws against employing undead are discriminatory. The city's lawyers, representing the [[Ravens Bluff Zoning Board|city zoning board]], counter-argue that DMHOC's employees are evil, bloodsucking creatures that shouldn't be allowed on the streets of Ravens Bluff.<ref name="poly109">{{Cite polyhedron/109/The Ravens Bluff Trumpeter|5}}</ref>{{Andonian-Time}}
* The [[Harpell]] family completes a bridge over the river [[Surbrin]].<ref name="North-p12" />
* A caravan master finds the ''[[Leaves of Green]]'' in the ruins of Zhentil Keep. He sells it in [[Arabel]] to someone who is killed in the [[Stonelands]] shortly afterward.<ref>{{Cite book/Prayers from the Faithful|50-51}}</ref>
* [[Calimport]] is devastated by the [[Trades Conflagaration|Trades Conflagration]], razing over 60% of [[Emerald Ward]] and 50% of [[Grand Ward]]. The Marekh [[sabban]] is wiped out, as are countless areas in the [[Muzad]].<ref name="tGHotR-149"/>
* This year is known as the Year of the City's Sorrows in the [[Black Chronology]].<ref name="C.TotW-159">{{Cite book/Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave|159}}</ref><ref name="TGHotR-157">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|157}}</ref>
* A trio of [[Solamnic Knights]] became stranded in [[Toril]] and ended up in [[Athkatla]].<ref name="soa">{{Cite game/Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn}}</ref>
*[[Anorrweyn Evensong]]'s [[ghost]] became one with Myth Drannor's ''mythal'' to restore it after its corruption beyond repair by the actions of Kya Mordrayn. [[Baelnorn]] [[Miroden Silverblade]], the previous guardian of the city's mythal was released from his eternal task.<ref name="POD2" />
* The [[Callidyr]]an merchant ship ''[[Green Hag (ship)|Green Hag]]'' is destroyed by it's own crew so as to prevent it from being captured by [[Iakhovas|Black Alaric]].<ref name="Dr362-GHotR" />

{{Yearbox/in-conflicts}}
* War erupts in southern [[Amn]] as [[Sythillis]] and his armies ally with the church of [[Cyric]], seeking [[Maztica]]n gold.<ref name="FRCS-p154">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|154}}</ref>
* War erupts in the [[Silver Marches]] as [[Obould Many-Arrows]] and his army of [[orc]]s, [[goblin]]s, and [[frost giant]]s  [[Shallows]] attack [[Mithral Hall]].<ref name="GHotR-p150">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|150}}</ref><ref name="1000orcs">{{Cite book/The Thousand Orcs/MMP}}</ref><ref name="2swords">{{Cite book/The Two Swords}}</ref>
*The [[Battle of Shallows]]: the village of [[Shallows]] is destroyed by the [[Many-Arrows]] horde.<ref name="1000orcs" />
*At the same time, [[Proffit]] and his army of [[troll]]s attack, conquer, and destroy [[Nesmé]].<ref name="2swords" />
*[[Mintar]] and the [[Church of Bane]] conquer the [[Tethyr]]ian town of [[Kzelter]].<ref>{{Cite dungeon/69/Sleep of Ages}}</ref>
*Three statues created from living beings transmuted by [[Vendes Baenre]] revert to living form, attacking their [[Gracklstugh]] owners before dissolving into water.<ref name="Guide-61">{{Cite book/Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark|61}}</ref>
*The navy of [[Ravens Bluff]] is destroyed in a surprise pirate attack. That same night, the city is attacked by a monstrous mercenary army led by [[Myrkyssa Jelan]]. Traitors in the government and the abduction of the Lord Mayor ensure chaos reigns for six months. If not for the large number of adventurers in the city at the time, Raven's Bluff would surely have fallen.<ref name="CoRB-5">{{Cite book/The City of Ravens Bluff|5}}</ref>
*Sea [[zombie]]s and the [[ghost]]s of pirates attack [[Telflamm]] but are turned back by the [[Church of Tempus]].<ref>{{Cite book/Cloak & Dagger|13}}</ref>
*The Royal Navy of the [[Moonshae Isles]] sinks twenty [[Nelanther Isles|Nelanther]] pirate ships in [[Firedrake Bay]] at the cost of only six of their own vessels.<ref name="Dr362-GHotR">{{Cite dragon/362/Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes|30}}</ref>
*A [[disease|plague]] strikes [[Waterdeep]]'s [[Waterdeep/Dock Ward|Dock Ward]], but is quickly contained by the city's [[priest]]s. A secretive group of [[werecat]]s known as the [[Eyes of the Evening]] determine that the outbreak was caused by a cult of [[Talona]]-worshiping [[wererat]]s.<ref name="P&P-p164">{{Cite book/Powers & Pantheons|164}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-deities}}
*[[Mirtul 3]]–[[Mirtul 11|11]]: [[Fzoul Chembryl]] summons the [[Tyrantfog]], slaying many [[Cyricist]]s across the [[Heartlands]] and empowering [[Iyachtu Xvim]] with the power of many [[Bane|Banite]] relics and holy sites.<ref name="C&Fp16">{{Cite book/Cloak and Dagger|16–17}}</ref>
*[[Nightal 24]]: After more than a decade of isolation from her followers, the goddess [[Waukeen]] is freed from her prison by a band of adventurers and resumes her place in the heavens. This date becomes another of the many holy days for the [[church of Waukeen]].<ref>{{Cite book/For Duty & Deity|58}}</ref><ref group="note">There is a discrepancy between ''[[For Duty & Deity]]'' and ''[[Faiths and Pantheons]]'' on the year Waukeen's rescue took place. The adventure module says the events take place late in the year 1370 DR and gives 24th Nightal as the official date of her return to godhood. The ''Faiths and Pantheons'' sourcebook says she was rescued and regained her divinity in 1371 DR.</ref>
*[[Tiamat]] begins channeling some of her divine power through the ''[[sphere of annihilation]]'' known as [[Entropy]], already worshiped in [[Luthcheq]]. The cultists begin receiving divine [[spell]]s from her and smaller spheres break off from the larger one, which the cultists can control. Tiamat also grants the cultists the service of some of her [[abishai]].<ref>{{Cite book/Lords of Darkness|136-137}}</ref>
*[[Lolth]]'s avatar steps through a portal deep in [[Undermountain]] to reclaim her long-lost ''[[Flame Sword of Lolth|Flame Sword]]'' hidden there by [[Halaster Blackcloak]]. The lone adventurer known only as the [[Khelbenite]] defeats the avatar with the artifact being destroyed in the ensuing explosion of divine energy.<ref name="Dec">{{Cite game/Descent to Undermountain}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/deaths}}
*[[Flamerule 7]]: Knight-Commanders [[Ian Graham]] and [[Carolyn Skyhawk]] are struck down by the [[Consortium of the Bloody Fang]], acting through the magically coerced [[Carston Willow]], who cast a ''[[lightning bolt]]'' at them as they were leaving a grand post-war ball being held at [[Griffon Hall]]. Knights and knight-squires rush the two off to the [[Halls of Morning Light]], where attending [[Lathanderite]]s manage to revive Carolyn Skyhawk, but are unable to save Ian Graham.<ref name="KM-p3-5">{{Cite organized play/LC/Knight Moves|3-5}}</ref>
*[[Duggan McKnuckles]], [[Bokkum]], and [[Stokkum]] are killed in an attack on their caravan by orcs and frost giants near the [[Spine of the World]], on their way to [[Shallows]].<ref name="tTO-p8">{{Cite book/The Thousand Orcs/MMP|8}}</ref>
*The Lord of [[Zhentil Keep]], [[Orgauth]], is slain by the fallen [[paladin]] [[Scyllua Darkhope]] as the final step to her becoming a [[blackguard]] mere months after Orgauth himself caused her to fall from grace.<ref>{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|164}}</ref>
*[[Dagna Waybeard]], dwarven general from Mithral Hall, is killed by trolls when he tries to protect refugees from destroyed Nesmé.<ref name="2swords" />
*[[Dagnabbit]], the son of dwarven general Dagna Waybeard, the lead military commander of Mithral Hall's armed forces, dies during the [[Battle of Shallows]].<ref name="2swords" />
* The insane priest of [[Kelemvor]], [[Vraer]] of [[Scornubel]], dies challenging the White Fate colony of [[beholder]]s for their territory southeast of [[Llorkh]].<ref name="PftF-p90">{{Cite book/Prayers from the Faithful|90}}</ref>
*[[Asborn Moonstar]] ventures into the Undermountain in search of a ''[[crystal rose]]'' and perishes in the pursuit.<ref name="Dec" />
*Undead [[necromancer]] [[Ghoulmaster]] sends resurrected members of the [[Cassalanter]] to attack citizens of Waterdeep before being slain by the Khelbenite.<ref name="Dec" />
* [[Horazak]], the devil-blooded [[orc]] slaver is slain in his Undermountain fortress.<ref name="Dec" />

{{Yearbox/in-environment}}
*The [[Shaking Plague]] strikes [[Scardale]], destroying much of the [[Sembia]]n garrison.<ref>{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|136-137}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/migrations}}
*Large numbers of [[fey]], of many varieties, migrate from [[Feywild|Faerie]] to [[Myrloch Vale]] and [[Winterglen Forest]] on [[Gwynneth]].<ref name="Dr362-GHotR" />

{{Yearbox/in-organizations}}
*The [[Church of Dugmaren]] establishes a temple called the [[Athenaeum of Philosophy]] in [[Silverymoon]] to ensure a [[dwarf|dwarven]] contribution to the collected knowledge of the new nation of [[Luruar]].<ref name="DD-p68">{{Cite book/Demihuman Deities|68}}</ref>
*The [[Tower of Swift Death]], a temple of [[Bhaal]] just outside [[Tyraturos]] in [[Thay]], officially switches to the worship of [[Cyric]], twelve years after the death of their god.<ref name="FA-p46">{{Cite book/Faiths & Avatars|46}}</ref>
*The [[Emerald Enclave]] seizes control of the [[Whamite Isles]].<ref name="SoFS-p13">{{Cite book/Sea of Fallen Stars|13}}</ref>
*The [[Shadow Thieves]] under the leadership of Grandmaster [[Xabash]] return to Waterdeep and ally with the [[drow]] forces of Matron [[Azurna]] to bring down the City of Splendors. The same year the Shadow Thieves' were driven out from their stronghold in Undermountain.<ref name="Dec" />
*[[Clangeddin's Hearth]] attempts to take over their ([[Clan Melairkyn]]) ancestral ground in the Undermountain only to be slaughtered by Matron Azurna's drown and their corpses reanimated as [[lich]]'s [[Morik Stormhand]]'s playthings.<ref name="Dec" />
*Alturiak: An abandoned barge washes up in [[Skullport]] on the [[River Sargauth]] and is impounded by the [[Skullport Island Registry]]. They aution off the most unusual piece of cargo, a [[white dragon]] egg, to the owners of [[Hired Horrors]]. Concerns arise in the town that the mysterious egg's parents might come looking for it.<ref name="S-p71">{{Cite book/Skullport|71}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-people}}
*[[Marpenoth 24]]: [[Nouméa Drathchuld]] relinquishes her role as [[Magister]] in favor of becoming one of [[Mystra]]'s [[Chosen of Mystra|Chosen]]. [[Azuth]] offers the position to [[Talatha Vaerovree]].<ref name="Secrets-84-85">{{Cite book/Secrets of the Magister|84-85}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-conflicts}}
* [[Nightal 20]]: [[Galaeron Nihmedu]] unwittingly releases the [[phaerimm]] from their prison under the dunes of [[Anauroch]], the phaerimm quickly isolate and besiege [[Evereska]].<ref name="SM-p99">{{Cite book/Silver Marches|99}}</ref><ref name="The Summoning">{{Cite book/The Summoning/Paperback 2001}}</ref><ref name="PGtF-p170">{{Cite book/Player's Guide to Faerûn|170}}</ref> 
* [[Nightal 26]]: [[Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun]] along with several other [[Chosen of Mystra]] muster a relief army in [[Waterdeep]] and set out to lift the phaerimm siege on Evereska.<ref name="PGtF-p170"/><ref name="The Sorcerer">{{Cite book/The Sorcerer/Paperback 2002}}</ref>
* Galaeron Nihmedu and [[Melegaunt Tanthul]], a [[prince of Shade]] travel to [[Karse]] where they recover the [[Karsestone]], destroying the [[lich]] [[Wulgreth]] who had used the stone as his [[phylactery]].<ref name="The Summoning"/>
* [[Nalavarauthatoryl]] leads an army of [[goblins]] and other monsters, despoiling much of [[Cormyr]]. The elf-dragon and King [[Azoun IV]] slay each other in battle. This conflict is often referred to as the [[Goblin War]].<ref>{{Cite book/Into the Dragon's Lair}}</ref>
* [[Drow]] of [[Clan Auzkovyn]] battle with priests of [[Tempus]] at the [[Abbey of the Sword]], after coming through an unguarded portal deep beneath the re-built castle.<ref name="FRCS3e-121">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|121}}</ref>
* Renegade [[sun elves]], [[human]] sea-wolves, and [[drow]] join together to attack the island of [[Evermeet]]. A powerful spell destroys the [[Tower of the Sun]] and one third of the island's mages are killed.<ref>{{Cite book/Forsaken House|6}}</ref>
* [[Menzoberranzan]]'s wizards, at the behest of [[Triel Baenre]] that completely eradicate the [[Svirfneblin]] city of [[Blingdenstone]]<ref name="TGHotR-151">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|151}}</ref> with summoned [[bebilith]]s.<ref name="U-129">{{Cite book/Underdark|129}}</ref>
*[[Mulhorand]] invades [[Unther]].<ref name="TGHotR-151"/>
* [[Nightal 28]] to [[Nightal 30]]: The [[Battle of Rocnest]], the first major battle in the siege of [[Evereska]].<ref name="PGtF-P170">{{Cite book/Player's Guide to Faerûn|170}}</ref>
* The [[Krollir Venasten|Righteous Man]], guildmaster of the [[Night Knives]] thieves' guild of [[Selgaunt]] and a powerful priest of [[Mask]], summons [[Yrsillar]], a mighty greater dread, to his temple beneath the guild headquarters. [[Drasek Riven]], one of his lieutenants and a secret member of the [[Zhentarim]], frees the demon by disrupting the protective circle containing it.<ref name="SW">{{Cite book/Shadow's Witness}}</ref>
* A [[lesser dread]] and a number of [[ghoul]]s attack [[Stormweather Towers]] in Selgaunt, slaying over twenty guests and house guards. [[Thazienne Uskevren]] is left gravely wounded.<ref name="SW" />
* With the help of [[Jak Fleet]], [[Erevis Cale]] infiltrates the Night Knives former headquarters and confronts Yrsillar.<ref name="SW" />
* [[Ches 30]]: [[Waterdeep]] is invaded by a host of [[sahuagin]], streaming forth from the [[Sea of Swords]].<ref>{{Cite book/The City of Splendors: A Waterdeep Novel/MMP|2-26|0}}</ref>
* [[Kythorn]]: A [[shimmerling]] swarm attacks the [[Northlander]] village of [[Grimstad]]. The survivors abandon what's left of it and within six months of the attack, the [[Winterglen]] overruns it's lands.<ref>{{Cite dragon/362/Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes|30}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-people}}

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* [[Eleint 14]]: An attempt is made on the life of [[Arklem Greeth]] by two members of the [[Arcane Brotherhood]]. Arklem survives but the old mage is badly injured and has to flee [[Luskan]]. He travels in secret to [[Mirabar]], where he meets [[Nyphithys]], an [[erinyes]] who helps him to become a [[lich]]. Revitalized in undeath, Arklem returns to the [[Hosttower of the Arcane|Host Tower]] with a force of summoned [[devil]]s and violently reclaims his place as Archmage Arcane. He then sets about rebuilding his broken organization and bringing the [[High Captains (Luskan)|High Captains]] under his sway again, after they had become more independent over the last few years.<ref>{{Cite book/Lords of Darkness|111}}</ref>
* [[Alustriel Silverhand]] assumes the title of "High Lady of the Silver Marches" and forms the League of the Silver Marches, officially turning the confederacy of [[Luruar]] into a new country.<ref name="SM-p7">{{Cite book/Silver Marches|7}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book/The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier/Cities & Civilization|55-56}}</ref>
* The [[Northlander]] kings swear fealty to High Queen [[Alicia Kendrick]], giving birth to a new nation titled the United [[Moonshae Isles]].<ref>{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide|152}}</ref>
* The [[zulkirs]] of [[Thay]], tired of incessant battles with [[Aglarond]], offer a truce. The [[Simbul]] accepts with reservations.<ref name="UE-p105">{{Cite book/Unapproachable East|105}}</ref>
* [[Orc]] warlord King [[Obould Many-Arrows]] established the [[Kingdom of Dark Arrows]], laying claim to the mountains west of the [[Moonwood]] and north of the [[Evermoors]].<ref name="TGHotR-151"/>

* '''Hammer:''' [[Marance Talendar]], a [[wizard]] slain by [[Thamalon Uskevren]] over three decades previous, is granted temporary leave from his liege lord in the [[Dis|Iron City of Dis]] to return to [[Faerûn]] and take revenge on his enemies. Over the course of a week, he nearly succeeds in slaying the elder [[Uskevren]] and their children, but is thwarted in the end by the family's matriarch, [[Shamur Uskevren|Shamur]].<ref name="TSM">{{Cite book/The Shattered Mask/Paperback 2007}}</ref>
* '''Tarsakh:''' [[Rusk]], Huntmaster of a tribe of [[People of the Black Blood]] in [[Arch Wood]], brings his pack to [[Selgaunt]] seeking revenge for the wounds given to him by [[Talbot Uskevren]], and in search of answers about the [[Black Wolf Prophecy]].<ref name="BW">{{Cite book/Black Wolf/MMP (2001)}}</ref>
* '''Mirtul 2''' [[Talontar Blightlords]] start to raise an army of [[Blightspawned]] to destroy the [[Circle of Leth]] and crush the [[Great Dale]].<ref name="TGHotR-p153">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|153}}</ref>
* '''Mirtul 27''' [[Tilverton]] suffers an attack by the forces of [[Thultanthar]] in [[Mirtul]]. All that is left of the town is a dark, concave space filled with shadows and flitting regions of deeper darkness.<ref name="The Siege">{{Cite book/The Siege/Paperback 2001}}</ref>
* Chieftain [[Grguch]] of [[Clan Karuck]], a rogue chieftain of [[Obould Many-Arrows|Obould]]'s horde attacks both the [[Moonwood]] and [[Mithral Hall]]'s new eastern wall. The attack on Moonwood most likely takes place in spring, after the thaw but before Wulfgar's return to Icewind Dale.<ref name="The Orc King">{{Cite book/The Orc King/Hardcover}}</ref>
* '''Eleint 23''' [[Kurgoth Hellspawn]] leads his army of [[giant]]s, [[demon]]s, and [[goblin]]s against the [[drow]] city of [[Maerimydra]].<ref>{{Cite dragon/354/Volo's Guide: Cormanthor: War Amidst the Trees|70}}</ref>
* '''Marpenoth''' As autumn falls over the Marches, a spectacular duel between two gigantic but unidentified [[dragon]]s enthralls many as it rages through the skies across the North.<ref name="SM-p99">{{Cite book/Silver Marches|99}}</ref>
* '''Uktar 3''' [[Ched Nasad]] is destroyed.<ref name="PGtF-p170">{{Cite book/Player's Guide to Faerûn|170}}</ref>
* '''Uktar 15''' [[Menzoberranzan]] is besieged by the forces of [[Kaanyr Vhok]].<ref name="PGtF-p170" />

A [[verdant prince]] is said to be organizing the fey on the isle. Men sent by [[Alicia Kendrick|High Queen Alicia]] are either turned away by the fey, or go missing.<ref>{{Cite dragon/362/Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes|30}}</ref>
* The autumn of 1372 DR in [[Tethyr]] marked the beginning and the end of the [[Bloody Fall]]. A short conflict between an [[ogre mage]] warlord [[Sythillis]] and the kingdom of Tethyr. The war's conclusion was the battle of [[Suldanessellar]] in which an unnamed hero battled the warlord and emerged victorious. The short but bloody conflict took several thousand lives and was later recorded in the ''[[Crimson Tides of Tethyr]]'' book of historic accounts.<ref name="moonsea">{{Cite game/Neverwinter Nights: Tyrants of the Moonsea}}</ref>

* The [[Fellowship of the Purple Staff|Purple Staves]] ally with the [[Nobanion]]ites of [[Gulthmere Forest]] when they realize that they have nothing to fear from the group's settlement of the area. Later in the year, the first three fortified hamlets are completed at the edge of the forest.<ref name="CoV-p80">{{Cite book/Champions of Valor|80}}</ref>
* Adventurers rescue [[Velvred Twohands]], the five-year-old son of High Lord [[Kalahar Twohands]] of [[Loudwater]], from agents of those who wish to kill his father.<ref name="UHLH-p12">{{Cite book/Under High Lord's Hall|3,12}}</ref>
* The [[Guardians of the Weave]] are founded by the [[Waterdeep|Waterdhavian]] [[wizard]] [[Aluvauna Thornym]] to combat the uptake of the [[Shadow Weave]] by magic-users.<ref name="CoV-p83">{{Cite book/Champions of Valor|83}}</ref>
* The [[Dungeon of the Hark]] is cleared by the [[Red Fellowship (Loudwater)]], an army out of Loudwater.<ref name="DotH">{{Cite book/Dungeon of the Hark}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-people}}
* '''Hammer 11''' [[Kern Desanea]], son of [[Tarl Desanea|Tarl]] and [[Shal Desanea]], the "Heroes of [[Phlan]]", recovers the ''Warhammer of Tyr''. In reward for helping with Kern's quest, the famed undead [[paladin]] [[Miltiades]] is returned to life by [[Tyr]].<ref name="TGHotR-p152">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|152}}</ref>
* '''Flamerule 1''' Wulfgar returns to Icewind Dale.<ref name="TGHotR-p153" />
* [[Elminster Aumar]] clashes with the [[Shadovar]], opening a rift to [[Avernus]] in the process. By expending his considerable magical repertoire Elminster closes the rift, only to be taken captive by the ex-[[archdevil]] [[Nergal]].<ref name="EiH-p1">{{Cite book/Elminster in Hell/Hardcover 2001|1}}</ref>
* '''[[Shieldmeet]]''' [[Otar]], a young [[orc]] chieftain from the [[High Forest]] becomes the new [[Green Regent]], much to the outrage of many influential citizens of [[Loudwater]].<ref name="LGR-WitGR" />
* Retirement of [[Vangerdahast]], leaving [[Caladnei]] as the sage of the [[Cormyrian]] court.<ref name="RoS">{{Cite book/Realms of Shadow/When Shadows Come Seeking a Throne}}</ref>
* The [[Malik el Sami yn Nasser|Seraph of Lies]] infiltrates [[Thultanthar]] on a mission from his wicked [[Cyric|master]]. He briefly gains control of the [[Karsestone]], but is eventually foiled by the [[Harper]] witch [[Ruha]].<ref name="The Sorcerer" />
* '''[[Mirtul]] 21''' [[Galaeron Nihmedu]] arrived in [[Cormyr]], bringing evidence that the [[Shadovar]]s were melting the [[High Ice]] and crippling the [[Interior Faerûn|Heartlands]].<ref name="GHotR-p153>{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|153}}</ref>

{{Yearbox/in-politics}}
* The [[Treaty of Garumn's Gorge]] is signed, officially recognizing the [[Many-Arrows|Kingdom of Many-Arrows]]. It is the first ever orc kingdom.<ref name="The Orc King" />
* Brisk trade continues between [[Aglarond]] and [[Thay]], despite Aglarondan wariness of the [[Red Wizards]].<ref name="UE-p105">{{Cite book/Unapproachable East|105}}</ref>
* [[Horgar Steelshadow V]] inherits the throne of [[Gracklstugh]].<ref name="OotA5e-p53">{{Cite book/Out of the Abyss|53}}</ref>
